Bonus

  • Experience preparing finance data for audit, SOX or IPO readiness.

  • Experience with pricing / packaging experimentation or revenue forecasting at a subscription or usage-based business.

  • Experience with dbt or a modern warehouse (BigQuery), partnering directly with analytics engineers.

Growth potential

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

  • Grow into a Lead Finance Data Scientist role as the central Data team scales.

  • Path into a Head of FP&A Analytics or data leadership track.

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe or the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in CET / ET timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, Warsaw, Dublin or New York.

Financial Operations Intern

About Dutchie

Founded in 2017, Dutchie is a comprehensive technology platform powering dispensary operations, while providing consumers with safe and easy access to cannabis. Dutchie aims to further support the positive societal change the cannabis industry brings to the world through wellness benefits, social justice, and empowering local communities through tax revenue. Powering thousands of dispensaries across 40+ markets throughout the United States and Canada, Dutchie is the leading technology company in the cannabis space and was named in Fast Company’s 10 Most Innovative Companies in North America and listed two years in a row on LinkedIn’s Top 50 Startups.

Dutchie has raised over $600M in funding to date, backed by D1 Capital Partners, Tiger Global, Dragoneer, DFJ Growth, Thrive Capital, Howard Schultz, Snoop Dogg’s Casa Verde Capital, Gron Ventures, members of the founding team at DoorDash, Kevin Durant’s Thirty Five Ventures, and other notable angel investors.

About This Job

We are seeking a Financial Operations Intern to support our Finance and Accounting teams with hands-on exposure to billing, cash application, collections, and partner payment processes. This role is ideal for a student or recent graduate looking to build practical experience in financial operations within a fast-paced environment. Reporting to the Revenue Lead, you will assist with a range of operational tasks that keep our billing, payments, and reconciliation processes running smoothly. This is a part-time role at approximately 30 hours per week.

What You'll Do…

  • Collections & Cash Application
    • Support collections efforts by engaging with customers to resolve payment issues professionally and efficiently.
    • Apply customer payments to appropriate accounts and ensure accurate record-keeping.
  • Reporting & Reconciliation
    • Prepare regular reports on payment status, cash reconciliations, and key metrics as appropriate.
    • Support month-end close activities by reconciling Accounts Receivable and contributing to financial reporting.
  • Collaboration
    • Work closely with cross-functional teams, including Collections, Sales, Customer Success, Implementation, and Business Systems, to address customer payment inquiries.
    • Assist with internal and external audits by providing requested documentation and supporting audit inquiries.
  • Process Improvement
    • Assist in the development and implementation of new processes and procedures to enhance the efficiency of accounts receivable.
    • Identify and recommend opportunities for process improvements in the order-to-cash cycle.
  • Customer & Payment Support
    • Investigate and respond to payment questions and requests
    • Monitor and respond to Zendesk tickets related to billing and payments.

What You Bring

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • Strong attention to detail and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage time effectively and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel; familiarity with financial or billing software (e.g., Salesforce, Sage Intacct, Zuora, Zendesk) is a plus.
  • A collaborative mindset and eagerness to learn financial operations fundamentals.
  • Experience with or exposure to AI-powered tools (e.g., through coursework or hands-on use), with an interest in leveraging AI to improve efficiency in financial operations.

You’ll Get…

The hourly rate for this internship is $18–$25/hour.

This is a temporary, hourly internship position and is not eligible for the full-time employee benefits package. Interns will receive company-provided technology needed to perform their work.

jobs.description:
Manager, Fund Administration (Accounting)

About Juniper Square

Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700,000+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come.

Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us!

Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time.

About your role

This is a great opportunity to join a growing initiative as we continue to evolve and scale Juniper Square’s fund administration service, filling a substantial market gap in the fund administration space. The service has had a huge impact across the business as it relates to workflow automation, leveraging technology to deliver up to par customer experience, and enabling GP's to strengthen relationships with LP's. As a Manager, Fund Administration, you will oversee deliverables focusing on fund administration services, including fund accounting and reporting, to Juniper Square’s Private Equity, Real Estate, and Real Estate Loan Fund customers. This role will manage a team of Fund Accountants at various levels. You will have a significant opportunity to help shape the trajectory of the function and in so doing help to deliver a best-in-class experience to our customers.

What you’ll do

  • Lead making strategic decisions regarding team buildout and operational policies and procedures

  • Lead efforts in developing and improving fund administration workflows, applying best practices and process efficiencies

  • Identify product development opportunities, routing technical, product feedback to the product development teams

  • Hire, train and manage a team of fund accountants

  • Interface directly with clients to deliver an outstanding client experience

  • Serve as a technical accounting expert and key advisor on significant business/accounting decisions for the team

  • Review and perform accounting, analytical, & financial reporting duties ensuring client and investor activity reporting is prepared and completed appropriately

  • Review investor allocations used to generate investor statements, waterfall calculations, capital calls and distributions in accordance with clients’ Limited Partnership Agreements, asset and fund level performance metrics and external client and financial reporting

  • Oversee annual audits including review of the initial draft of the annual audit report and related schedules and disclosures; assist with PBC list (Prepared By Client) and tax returns

  • Research and provide guidance in interpreting the impact of recent accounting developments

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of fund accounting experience in private equity, venture capital, real estate, and/or real estate loan (private debt) funds required

  • 3+ years of people management experience (hiring, building teams, performance management, coaching, career development)

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or a related field

  • Comfortable with ambiguity within a hyper-growth, startup environment

  • Experience with fund-level accounting and reporting including complex fund structures and consolidations

  • Advanced understanding of complex accounting transactions, private equity investment structures, and reporting requirements for private equity funds

  • Advanced knowledge of waterfall, performance metrics (IRRs), distributions and capital calls calculations

  • Passion for technology and a desire to use technology to improve business operations

  • Experience scoping out system requirements and implementing new systems

At Juniper Square, we believe building a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture makes us a better company. If you think this job sounds like a fit, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the qualifications.

Compensation

Compensation for this position includes a base salary, equity, and a variety of benefits. The U.S. base salary range for this role is $130,000-$140,000 USD. The Canadian base salary for this role is $140,000-150,000 CAD. Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable.

Benefits include:

jobs.title: Go-to-Market Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Go-to-Market Engineer (m/w/d)

Wir bauen die Software, mit der WEG- und Mietverwaltungen ihren Alltag rechtssicher und ohne Medienbrüche organisieren, umfangreich und modern, aber erschwinglich, für das digitale Zeitalter der Immobilienwirtschaft. Die Immobilienverwaltung zählt zu den analogsten Branchen in Deutschland, genau das wollen wir ändern.

Unser Team kombiniert Erfahrung aus dem Verwalteralltag mit dem IT-Know-how eines innovativen Tech-Unternehmens. Seit unserer Gründung 2020 sind wir aus der Praxis für die Praxis gewachsen. Wir sind ein Team von 26 Menschen in Brühl bei Köln, das Verantwortung ernst nimmt und Entscheidungen schnell trifft.

Wir wachsen und mit uns die Anforderungen an unsere Infrastruktur über Marketing, Vertrieb und Customer Success hinweg. Dafür suchen wir keine Person, die HubSpot verwaltet, sondern jemanden, der sie baut: Strukturen, Automatisierungen und Tracking, die den gesamten Weg vom ersten Kontakt bis zur langfristigen Kundenbeziehung sauber abbilden. Du berichtest direkt an unsere CRO.

Aufgaben

  • Du übernimmst HubSpot als zentrale Infrastruktur für Marketing, Vertrieb und Customer Success und baust Strukturen, die mit unserem Wachstum mitskalieren.
  • Du entwickelst Automatisierungen, die manuelle Arbeit aus unseren Teams herausnehmen, von Content-Automatisierung über Lead-Routing bis zu automatisierten Abläufen im Customer Success, etwa beim Onboarding neuer Kund:innen.
  • Du baust mit n8n oder vergleichbaren Low-Code-Tools Workflows, die Systeme miteinander verbinden, die bisher nebeneinander laufen.
  • Du setzt KI gezielt dort ein, wo sie echten Mehrwert bringt: bei Recherche, Optimierung, Datenanreicherung oder Content-Erstellung.
  • Bei Bedarf baust du auch mal eine Landingpage in Webflow oder ein Tracking-Setup, das uns zeigt, was auf dem Weg zum Kunden tatsächlich funktioniert.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Marketing, Vertrieb und Customer Success zusammen und verstehst deren Prozesse gut genug, um sie in Systeme zu übersetzen, die im Alltag wirklich helfen.

Qualifikation

  • Gute bis sehr gute HubSpot-Kenntnisse: Du hast bereits Strukturen aufgebaut, nicht nur gepflegt, und weißt, wie Workflows, Properties und Automatisierungen zusammenspielen.
  • Fortgeschrittene Erfahrung mit Automatisierung über Low-Code- oder No-Code-Tools wie n8n.
  • Echtes Interesse an KI und was sie im Business-Kontext leisten kann. Du musst kein Profi sein, aber du hast bereits ausprobiert, gelernt und weißt, wo KI wirklich hilft und wo nicht.
  • Ein Systemblick: Du denkst in Prozessen über Teamgrenzen hinweg, nicht in einzelnen Tickets, hast das Gesamtsystem im Kopf und weißt, wie sich eine Änderung an einer Stelle an anderer Stelle auswirkt.
  • Technikaffinität, die über HubSpot hinausgeht. Ein Tool wie Webflow schreckt dich nicht ab.
  • Bock, in einem Startup mitzugestalten, statt in einem eingespielten Prozess zu verwalten.

Wer zu uns passt

Wir suchen niemanden, der schon alles kann. Wir suchen jemanden mit echtem Interesse an der Aufgabe. Jemanden, der Automatisierung und KI nicht nur kennt, sondern gerne selbst in die Hand nimmt. Wichtig ist, dass du KI oder Automatisierung bereits im Business-Kontext eingesetzt, nicht nur privat ausprobiert hast. Das kann jemand mit ersten Erfahrungen sein, der Lust hat, sich weiter reinzuarbeiten, oder jemand mit viel Erfahrung, der Bock auf die nächste Stufe hat. Senior oder Expertin musst du dafür nicht sein. Entscheidend ist, dass dir das Bauen selbst Spaß macht, nicht nur das Ergebnis.

Was SCALARA bietet

Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit unserem CRO und echte Verantwortung ab dem ersten Tag.

Die Möglichkeit, eine Infrastruktur von Grund auf mitzugestalten, statt eine bestehende zu verwalten.

Ein Tech-Unternehmen, das auf Innovation und KI setzt und in dem gute Ideen schnell umgesetzt werden.

Arbeitskultur: Ein offenes, wertschätzendes Team von 26 Menschen in Brühl bei Köln, das eng zusammenarbeitet und mit Herzblut und Spaß bei der Sache ist.

Flexibilität: Hybrides Arbeiten zwischen Büro in Brühl und Home-Office, remote Arbeiten auf Anfrage.

jobs.description:
Werkstudent Grafik

Über uns

Kijimea – Aus der Forschung. Für Dein Leben. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2011 verfolgen wir eine klare Vision: Wir möchten das Potenzial der Mikrobiota (Bakterien) in unserem Darm gezielt nutzen für ein längeres und gesünderes Leben - für alle Menschen.

Ein erster großer Meilenstein auf diesem Weg gelang uns bereits 2013 mit der Entdeckung und klinischen Erforschung des einzigartigen Bakterienstamms B. bifidum MIMBb75 (Kijimea Reizdarm). Seitdem konnten wir das Leben von Millionen Reizdarmpatienten weltweit spürbar verbessern. Heute gehört B. bifidum MIMBb75 zu den am besten erforschten Bakterienstämmen weltweit. Seine Wirksamkeit und sein einzigartiger Wirkmechanismus wurden in zahlreichen klinischen Studien nachgewiesen und publiziert – u.a. in renommierten Fachzeitschriften wie The Lancet.

Wir arbeiten mit führenden Forschungsinstitutionen wie der Charité Berlin zusammen, um die Zusammenhänge zwischen der Mikrobiota (Bakterien in unserem Darm) und Allergien, Hautkrankheiten und psychischen Störungen zu erforschen. Kurz gesagt: Wir untersuchen, wie die Bakterien in unserem Darm Einfluss auf ein längeres und gesünderes Leben nehmen.

Heute zählen wir zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare-Unternehmen weltweit. Unsere Kunden erreichen wir über verschiedenste Kanäle: über die direkte Kommunikation mit Ärzten und Apothekern sowie Print-, TV- und Digitalmarketing. Um unser stark wachsendes Geschäft in Europa weiter auszubauen, suchen wir herausragende Talente, die uns bei dieser Mission unterstützen. Unser Ziel ist klar definiert: Bis 2028 wollen wir Kijimea zur weltweit größten DTC-Probiotikamarke machen und damit jährlich über 50 Millionen Menschen ein besseres Leben schenken.

Für Dich klingt das spannend? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.

Deine Mission bei uns

Du willst hinter die Kulissen eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare-Unternehmen Europas schauen und dabei Deine Kreativität in echte Projekte einbringen? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig!

Wir suchen ab sofort einen Werkstudenten (w/m/d) im Bereich Grafik, der unser Team vor allem bei der Umsetzung und Bearbeitung von Video-Content unterstützt. Du hilfst dabei, Videomaterial zu schneiden, für verschiedene Kanäle wie Social Media und Amazon aufzubereiten und in passende Formate zu übertragen. Zudem unterstützt Du uns bei der Gestaltung und Anpassung von Print- und Online-Assets und trägst dazu bei, unsere Inhalte visuell ansprechend und markengerecht umzusetzen.

Hilf uns dabei, die Marke Kijimea – bereits heute eine der führenden Probiotika-Marken weltweit –noch erfolgreicher zu machen.

 

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du unterstützt bei der Gestaltung und Umsetzung von Printmedien wie Flyern, Broschüren, Postern und Verpackungen innerhalb unserer Corporate-Design-Vorgaben.

  • Du passt Grafiken und Layouts für Print- und Online-Assets an und achtest dabei auf eine konsistente Darstellung sowie die Einhaltung unserer CD-Vorgaben.

  • Du bearbeitest und optimierst Fotos und Grafiken, führst Bildrecherchen durch und unterstützt bei der Auswahl und Archivierung von Bildmaterial.

  • Du hilfst bei der Konzeption und Gestaltung von Online-Werbemitteln, Landingpages und weiteren digitalen Assets.

  • Du unterstützt bei der Bearbeitung von Videos – insbesondere beim einfachen Videoschnitt, bei Formatanpassungen für Amazon und Social Media sowie bei Sprachadaptionen.

  • Du erstellst bei Bedarf einfache Animationen und unterstützt bei der Recherche geeigneter Stockvideos und Audiofiles.

  • Du bringst eigene Ideen ein und unterstützt uns dabei, unsere Inhalte visuell ansprechend und zielgruppengerecht umzusetzen.

 

Dein Profil

  • Du befindest Dich in einem laufenden Studium, idealerweise in einem Studiengang mit Bezug zu Grafikdesign, Mediendesign, Kommunikationsdesign, Medien, Marketing oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung.

  • Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Gestaltung, Typografie, Farben und Formen sowie Freude an visuellen Themen.

  • Du verfügst über erste praktische Erfahrungen in der Gestaltung von Print- oder Online-Materialien – beispielsweise aus dem Studium, eigenen Projekten, Praktika oder studentischen Tätigkeiten.

Über uns

Seitdem konnten wir das Leben von Millionen Reizdarmpatienten weltweit spürbar verbessern. Heute gehört B. bifidum MIMBb75 zu den am besten erforschten Bakterienstämmen weltweit. Seine Wirksamkeit und sein einzigartiger Wirkmechanismus wurden in zahlreichen klinischen Studien nachgewiesen und publiziert – u.a. in renommierten Fachzeitschriften wie The Lancet.

Wir arbeiten mit führenden Forschungsinstitutionen wie der Charité Berlin zusammen, um die Zusammenhänge zwischen der Mikrobiota (Bakterien in unserem Darm) und Allergien, Hautkrankheiten und psychischen Störungen zu erforschen. Kurz gesagt: Wir untersuchen, wie die Bakterien in unserem Darm Einfluss auf ein längeres und gesünderes Leben nehmen.

Heute zählen wir zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare-Unternehmen weltweit. Unsere Kunden erreichen wir über verschiedenste Kanäle: über die direkte Kommunikation mit Ärzten und Apothekern sowie Print-, TV- und Digitalmarketing. Um unser stark wachsendes Geschäft in Europa weiter auszubauen, suchen wir herausragende Talente, die uns bei dieser Mission unterstützen. Unser Ziel ist klar definiert: Bis 2028 wollen wir Kijimea zur weltweit größten DTC-Probiotikamarke machen und damit jährlich über 50 Millionen Menschen ein besseres Leben schenken.

Für Dich klingt das spannend? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.

Deine Mission bei uns

Du möchtest die Web-Präsenz sowie die gesamte technische Infrastruktur in einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare-Unternehmen Europas mitgestalten und verantworten? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig!

Wir suchen ab sofort einen Trainee Web Development (w/m/d) für unser 24-monatiges Traineeprogramm. Werde Teil unseres erfahrenen Web-Teams und lerne die technische Infrastruktur hinter unseren E-Commerce Shops und Online-Auftritten kennen. Entwickle Dich mit uns fachlich und persönlich weiter, übernehme echte Verantwortung und trage dazu bei, unsere Vision eines gesünderen und längeren Lebens für Millionen Menschen Wirklichkeit werden zu lassen.

 

Deine Aufgaben

Dein Studium hast Du abgeschlossen und Du brennst jetzt darauf, innerhalb eines Unternehmens Deine nächsten Schritte zu gehen? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig! In unserem 24-monatigen Traineeprogramm Frontend Development erwirbst Du schnell fundierte Kenntnisse für alle Themenfelder innerhalb der Frontend Development Bereiche eines im E-Commerce und Online-Marketing führenden Pharmaunternehmens. Wir wollen uns mit Dir fachlich und persönlich weiterentwickeln!

In den 24 Monaten des Traineeprogramms durchläufst Du zwei bis drei Stationen und kannst hier bei einem der deutschlandweit führenden Unternehmen im Pharma-Marketing Deine Kompetenzen auf- und ausbauen.
Folgende Bereiche können Teil Deines Traineeships sein:

  • Shopify Team: Du lernst die Tool-Landschaft und Infrastruktur unserer E-Commerce Auftritte kennen, die wir rund um Shopify Plus als führendes System aufgebaut haben. Du lernst im Detail unseren auf konsequenten A/B-Tests beruhenden Ansatz zur Weiterentwicklung unserer Storefronts kennen. Zusammen mit unserem Team entwickelst Du unsere Store Fronts weiter, startest neue Projekte und sorgst für reibungslose interne Abläufe und Datenflüsse.

  • Web Development Team: Du lernst die technische Infrastruktur unserer Online-Auftritte abseits von Shopify kennen. Im Zentrum stehen hierbei A/B-Tests zur Verbesserung der Nutzererfahrung und Conversion Rate sowie die technische Betreuung und Optimierung des Performance Marketings für diverse Websites. Du sorgst zusammen mit dem Team dafür, dass unsere Websites auf allen Geräten und Browsern einwandfrei funktionieren.

  • Business Intelligence (BI) Online-Marketing: Daten sind bei uns die Grundlage aller Entscheidungen. Wir sind davon überzeugt, dass Erfolg im Online-Marketing und E-Commerce nur von Unternehmen erreicht werden kann, die konsequent in Dateninfrastruktur investieren und Daten als Wettbewerbsvorteil sehen. Im BI-Team stellen wir die Verfügbarkeit und Konsistenz von Online-Marketing- und E-Commerce-Daten sicher. Gleichzeitig unterstützen wir die Fachbereiche mit konkreten Analysen, um so datenbasierte Entscheidungen treffen zu können.

 

Dein Profil

  • Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Informatik, (Wirtschafts-) Informatik, Betriebswirtschaftslehre oder einem ähnlichen Studiengang.

  • Du willst alles Rund um die Themen digitale Infrastruktur, Data Analytics, Tagging & Tracking sowie E-Commerce lernen.

  • Du verfügst entweder bereits über Kenntnisse in den Bereich WordPress, HTML, CSS, JS, Shopify Liquid oder bist interessiert daran und fähig, Dir diese mit Unterstützung unseres Teams schnell anzueignen. Erfahrung mit digitalem Performance Marketing sowie E-Mail-Marketing sind gern gesehen, aber nicht erforderlich.

  • Du arbeitest gerne eigenständig, lösungsorientiert und mit einem gesunden Pragmatismus. Du hast einen hohen Anspruch an die Qualität und die Ergebnisse Deiner Arbeit.

  • Du hast Spaß daran, Dich in neue Technologien einzuarbeiten und Dich kontinuierlich weiterzubilden.

jobs.title: Head of Management Accounts
jobs.description:
Head of Management Accounts

About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing the Trainline Financial Control Team 👋

Trainline is Europe's leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels. Our Financial Control team sits at the heart of how we understand and run the business, owning the quality and integrity of our management accounts, balance sheet and month end processes. As Head of Management Accounts, you'll lead a team through two Senior Finance Managers, covering the P&L from Revenue to Adjusted EBITDA (one above Gross Margin, one below), acting as the go-to expert for complex accounting judgement and the person who joins the dots across Financial Control, FP&A and the wider business.

You'll scale through your team rather than through the detail, empowering them to own the underlying processes end to end while you remain accountable for outcomes and standards, acting as the escalation point for judgement calls and the driver of improvement and projects. Beyond Financial Control, you'll be a natural point of contact for cross-functional work, partnering with teams including Legal, Commercial, Product and Technology to translate complex or ambiguous problems into a clear, well documented plan. Reporting into the Group Financial Controller, you'll build broad enough knowledge across external reporting, governance, working capital and FP&A to deputise when needed, and you'll represent Financial Control with authority across the business.

In this role as the Head of Management Accounts, you will...🚄

  • Lead the team within Financial Control, principally through two direct reports, acting as a role model who coaches and mentors to build capability, delegates effectively, holds the team to a high standard of delivery and keeps development and succession front of mind

  • Act as a thought leader within the team, bringing structure and clarity to complex or ambiguous problems and documenting conclusions so they can be applied consistently across the function

  • Lead cross-functional projects from beginning to end, working with teams including Legal, Commercial, Product and Technology, setting and holding a timeline and navigating senior stakeholder relationships to land a single, well-documented position

  • Hold accountability for the smooth, timely running of month end, including balance sheet integrity, key reconciliations and working capital analysis, with the team owning execution and you providing judgement and sign off, critically reviewing management accounts output for risks, inconsistencies and control gaps and ensuring a consistently high-quality, on-time, audit-ready close

  • Act as the subject matter expert for external reporting and controls, providing technical challenge on Annual Report and Half-Year Report verification activity, owning accounting policy judgements and their documentation, and liaising with external auditors on balance sheet and reporting matters as needed

  • Be accountable for a strong internal control environment, and drive continuous improvement and automation to reduce manual effort and improve the quality of outputs

  • Hold the team accountable for effective Order-to-Cash processes across the group, maintaining strong control and discipline, while proactively identifying emerging risks or areas of complexity

  • Own the cost budgeting process in partnership with FP&A, ensuring cost centre owners work to a clear timetable, challenge assumptions and are well prepared to present to the CFO, and build a team that acts as trusted finance partners across the business, providing insight and challenge that shapes commercial decisions, stepping in personally for the most complex or senior conversations

  • Maintain strong awareness of corporate governance as a listed business, provide senior oversight of working capital performance including Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable, and deputise for the Group Financial Controller as required, including representing Financial Control at key forums

We'd love to hear from you if you have...🔍

  • Qualified accountant status (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent) with significant post-qualification experience running month end, balance sheet, reconciliation and working capital processes in a complex business

  • Experience managing and developing senior finance managers or teams, including setting direction and managing performance through others, with a track record of holding teams to high standards

  • Strong technical knowledge of IFRS and listed-company governance, and confidence making accounting policy judgements

  • A strong track record of business partnering with senior, non-finance stakeholders to shape commercial decisions

  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trust quickly, manage upwards, delegate effectively and run a project from beginning to end

  • A collaborative leadership style that empowers teams to own delivery, while you stay accountable for standards and outcomes

  • Experience of ERP platforms or finance automation tools

  • Experience in a listed or multi-currency business would be an advantage, though not essential

More information:

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. 

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! 

We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.

Our values represent the things that matter most to us and what we live and breathe everyday, in everything we do: 

  • 💭 Think Big - We're building the future of rail 

  • ✔️ Own It - We focus on every customer, partner and journey 

  • 🤝  Travel Together - We're one team 

  • ♻️ Do Good - We make a positive impact 

We know that having a diverse team makes us better and helps us succeed. And we mean all forms of diversity - gender, ethnicity, sexuality, disability, nationality and diversity of thought. That's why we're committed to creating inclusive places to work, where everyone belongs and differences are valued and celebrated.

Interested in finding out more about what it's like to work at Trainline? Why not check us out on LinkedIn, Instagram and Glassdoor!

jobs.title: Data Scientist – Computational Genomics, 12-month FTC
jobs.description:
Data Scientist – Computational Genomics, 12-month FTC

About Relation

Relation is a sector defining TechBio company developing transformational medicines, with technology at our core. Our ambition is to understand human biology in unprecedented ways, discovering therapies to treat some of life’s most devastating diseases. We leverage single-cell multi-omics from patient tissue, functional assays, and machine learning to drive disease understanding, from cause to cure.

We are scaling rapidly and building a team of exceptional individuals to push the boundaries of drug discovery. You will work in highly interdisciplinary teams where biology, computation, and engineering come together to solve complex problems that have not been solved before. Our state-of-the-art wet and dry labs in the heart of London are designed to accelerate this integration and translate insight into impact.

We are committed to building diverse and inclusive teams. Relation is an equal opportunities employer and does not discriminate on the basis of gender, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, gender reassignment, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, disability, or age.

By joining Relation, you will help define how medicines are discovered and deliver meaningful impact for patients.

The opportunity

This is a unique opportunity for a Data Scientist to bridge the gap between computational genomics and machine learning at scale. Operating at the genomics-ML interface, you will shape our computational genomics efforts to accelerate target identification and validation across diverse therapeutic areas, leveraging large-scale human genetics resources — genetic discovery, biobanks, OMICs, single-cell atlases and other internal datasets— to gain actionable insight. By building, refining and deploying cutting-edge ML-focussed methods you will inform robust functional prioritisation frameworks, mechanistic hypotheses, and strategic decision-making across the organisation.

Day to Day you will:

  • Apply, build, refine and integrate statistical models to gain insight from genomics, transcriptomics and other OMICs datasets and support target discovery and validation.

  • Work cross-functionally at the ML-genetics interface to identify opportunities, solve problems and implement solutions for shared insight

  • Integrate human genetics evidence with OMICs datasets (e.g. transcriptomics, proteomics) to uncover disease mechanisms and prioritise actionable targets.

  • Develop scalable computational workflows for reproducible analysis within Relation’s existing stack

  • Partner closely with experimental and machine learning researchers to validate hypotheses, interpret results, and guide downstream studies.

  • Communicate findings clearly to internal stakeholders, including presenting methods, results, and recommendations.

  • Contribute to publications, scientific communications, and project documentation, supporting scientific excellence and external visibility.

Professionally, you will have

  • PhD in statistical genetics, genomics, computational biology, machine learning, bioinformatics, or a related quantitative field.

  • Knowledge of machine learning techniques applied to biological data

  • Experience in quantitative genomics, statistics, bioinformatics, or multi-omics data analysis.

  • Proficiency in Python (preferred), or R, and familiarity with high-performance computing environments, collaborative coding and version control (e.g. git)

  • Bonus experience:

    • Familiarity with single-cell transcriptomics or patient-derived datasets.

    • Experience working in interdisciplinary/matrixed teams within biotech or pharma settings.

    • Understanding of the end-to-end drug discovery process and how genetic evidence informs decision-making.

Personally, you:

Are comfortable working in a matrixed environment, balancing multiple stakeholders and contributing effectively across teams.

Take ownership of your work, proactively seek opportunities to contribute, and enable others to do their best work.

Communicate openly and directly, give and receive feedback constructively, and handle challenging conversations with respect.

Actively seek out diverse perspectives, build strong working relationships, and contribute to shared goals across teams.

Embrace challenges with openness and resilience, set high standards for yourself, and strive to deliver meaningful outcomes.

Senior Backend Engineer - Ledger Platform

Senior Back-End Engineer - Ledger Platform

Hybrid in London (UK) or Remote within the UK

We’re looking for a Senior Back-End Engineer

This role is a chance to tackle complex, high-impact challenges at the heart of our fintech platform. You will join the team that owns iwoca's ledger — the system of record for the money we lend and collect — and you will be responsible for scaling it across the full lifecycle of our credit card and lending products, building the reconciliation and reporting that prove it correct, and laying the foundations for our next generation of products. This is a hands-on role: you'll design these systems, write the code, and own them in production.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

The Ledger Platform team owns the ledger across all of iwoca's products, from credit cards to our lending range, plus everything around it: reconciliation, financial reporting, and the data Finance, Accounting and Capital Markets run on. We work closely with a Product Manager, shipping frequently and owning our systems in production. Some of the team work fully remotely and others are hybrid, working 1-3 days per week in the London office.


The role

Responsibility and Autonomy:

  • Lead the delivery of projects involving many stakeholders and systems.

  • Go beyond the code to develop deep expertise in our domain — our core financial products and our stakeholders' needs — and become a trusted technical advisor to the business.

  • Perform detailed technical scoping and prototyping to support feasibility testing and decision making.

Delivery and Collaboration

  • Architect and implement scalable solutions for complex challenges: the lifecycle of an account, interest and repayment allocation, reconciliation, and how financial data reaches our reporting stack.

  • Use domain modelling to find the simple design behind a complicated problem, and structure software so that it is easy to understand, test and evolve.

  • Be pragmatic about which parts of a problem actually need solving now. The hardest work here is deciding what not to build.

  • Build solutions that avoid single points of failure, and make sure our releases happen with zero downtime.

  • Translate ambiguous product requirements into clear, actionable technical plans that guide the team's work.

  • Promptly investigate and fix live issues, and ensure they do not resurface. Own what you ship in production and keep it reliable and easy to operate.

  • Contribute high-quality, production-ready code and foster a collaborative environment by reviewing work and writing useful documentation.

Learning and Growth:

  • Work with the team to improve our development and agile practices and raise our engineering standards.

  • Share new approaches and tooling with the wider engineering group through our internal forums and company-wide talks.

AI:

  • We're pushing hard on AI-assisted development. Engineers here write clear technical specs, let skills and agents implement boiler-plate, and hold a high bar on code review — the person, not the model, is accountable for what merges. We expect AI output to be validated for correctness, performance and security like any other change.

  • We give the team unlimited tokens across all models and expect people to experiment.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Extensive back-end engineering experience.

  • Experience building and running microservices and distributed systems in production. Comfortable reasoning about durable cross-service communication, transactional correctness, and failure modes at scale.

  • Extensive experience with relational databases, ideally PostgreSQL, but open to MySQL or similar (e.g., MS SQL, Oracle); emphasis is on data integrity.

  • Experience with systems where correctness is a hard requirement — ledgers, accounting, billing or payments, ideally in a regulated setting — including the invariants, immutable audit trails and reconciliation controls that enforce it.

  • Experience leading a feature or project end to end — scoping, design, delivery, and running it in production.

  • You use AI (like Cursor, Claude Code or similar) in your daily flow - whether for work or for fun. You use it to blast through boilerplate and research, so you can focus on the hard parts: complex architecture, rigour, and high-stakes decision-making.

  • A strong technical or mathematical foundation, evidenced by a degree in a quantitative field (Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Maths or similar) or equivalent professional experience.

  • You work well as a peer: pairing on hard problems, giving useful code review, and unblocking teammates day-to-day.

  • Clear written and verbal communication — you can explain a technical trade-off to Finance, and a business constraint back to engineers.

Bonus:

  • A background in high-logic or high-scale fields like Fintech, Gaming, Healthcare Tech, Logistics, Security/Cryptography or similar.

  • Working knowledge of modern data tooling - ideally Snowflake and dbt - used to build analytical or reporting pipelines.

  • Knowledge of messaging frameworks and event-driven patterns (e.g. Kafka).

The salary

We expect to pay from £80,000 to £110,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Senior Technical Program Manager, Applied AI

About LILT

AI is changing how the world communicates — and LILT is leading that transformation.

We're on a mission to make the world's information accessible to everyone, regardless of the language they speak. We use cutting-edge AI, machine translation, and human-in-the-loop expertise to translate content faster, more accurately, and more cost-effectively without compromising on brand, voice, or quality.

At LILT, we empower our teammates with leading tools, global collaboration, and growth opportunities to do their best work. Our company virtues—Work together, win together; Find a way or make one; Dance in the customer's shoes; Quicker than they expect; Quality is Job 1—guide everything we do. We are trusted by Intel Corporation, Canva, the United States Department of Defense, the United States Air Force, ASICS, and hundreds of global Enterprises. Backed by Sequoia, Intel Capital, and Redpoint, we’re building a category-defining company in a $50B+ global translation market being redefined by AI.

About the Role:

As a Senior TPM of Applied AI, you will sit at the intersection of cutting-edge research and industrial-scale execution. You will operate with an entrepreneurial mindset, effectively acting as the CEO of your customer's business to proactively drive success. You are responsible for leading complex benchmark transformations and data deliverables. Rather than just managing timelines, you are architecting workflows to ensure the next generation of LLMs and multimodal models are trained on the most accurate, diverse, and complex data available, while championing innovative solutions alongside our research lab partners.

  • Entrepreneurial Benchmark Leadership: Act as the CEO of your customer’s business by proactively proposing and co-developing benchmark transcreations directly with research lab partners, ensuring our deliverables are innovative, tailored, and aligned with their core research objectives.

  • Frontier Lab Program Management: Lead the end-to-end execution of high-priority technical programs for frontier AI labs, managing the delivery of massive-scale datasets and bespoke engineering milestones.

  • High-Volume Data Operations: Architect and oversee pipelines for delivering high-volume data samples across multiple modalities (text, image, video, audio), ensuring strict adherence to delivery cadences without sacrificing precision.

  • End-to-End Quality Control: Partner with production to implement rigorous, automated, and human-in-the-loop QC frameworks to ensure data integrity across various domains and languages.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Bridge the gap between forward-deployed engineering resources, research, and production teams to ensure LILT can serve the needs of the frontier AI market.

Qualifications

  • Education: B.S or M.S. in Computer Science, AI, or a related technical field with 10+ years of industry experience. Equivalently, a Ph.D. with 5+ years of experience in a high-growth AI/Engineering environment.

  • Entrepreneurial Mindset: Experience founding or scaling a venture, or operating in an early-stage startup environment where you drove business growth and strategic initiatives from the ground up.

  • Strategic Execution: Strong business acumen and the ability to manage high-stakes stakeholder relationships with frontier AI labs.

  • Frontier AI Expertise: Proven track record of managing data pipelines for LLMs or multimodal models. Deep understanding of training, inference, and the nuances of data diversity (multilingual and multi-domain).

  • Scale & Quality: Demonstrated ability to manage "high-throughput" programs where quality control is mission-critical. You should have experience with automated validation at scale.

Preferred Skills

  • Fluency in multiple human languages.

  • Proficiency in Python and experience working with modern AI frameworks (PyTorch, LangChain, etc.).

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.

  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technology in a rapidly growing industry.

  • A dynamic and collaborative work environment.

  • Significant opportunities for professional growth and development.

  • The chance to make a real impact on global communication and business.

Where You’ll Work

This position is based in our London, UK office and will be expected to work in the office in a hybrid capacity. Boston and Indianapolis are also acceptable locations. LILT is hybrid with hubs in SF, NY, Indianapolis, Boston, London, and Berlin.

 

Authorization to work in the U.S. is a precondition of employment.

  • London, UK (highly preferred)

  • Others: Berlin, Boston, New York, Indianapolis

Our Story

Our founders, Spence and John met at Google working on Google Translate. As researchers at Stanford and Berkeley, they both worked on language technology to make information accessible to everyone. While together at Google, they were amazed to learn that Google Translate wasn’t used for enterprise products and services inside the company.The quality just wasn’t there. So they set out to build something better. LILT was born.

LILT has been a machine learning company since its founding in 2015. At the time, machine translation didn’t meet the quality standard for enterprise translations, so LILT assembled a cutting-edge research team tasked with closing that gap. While meeting customer demand for translation services, LILT has prioritized investments in Large Language Models, human-in-the-loop systems, and now agentic AI.

With AI innovation accelerating and enterprise demand growing, the next phase of LILT’s journey is just beginning.

Our Tech

What sets our platform apart:

  • Brand-aware AI that learns your voice, tone, and terminology to ensure every translation is accurate and consistent

  • Agentic AI workflows that automate the entire translation process from content ingestion to quality review to publishing

  • 100+ native integrations with systems like Adobe Experience Manager, Webflow, Salesforce, GitHub, and Google Drive to simplify content translation

  • Human-in-the-loop reviews via our global network of professional linguists, for high-impact content that requires expert review


LILT in the News

jobs.description:
Legal AI Counsel (Zurich)
Description

Legartis is on a mission: to unlock legal work at scale.

We set the standard for AI-powered contract review. Today we build a holistic platform that changes how legal teams operate from review to negotiation, powered by our Legal Agent. We are looking for the person who makes that value real for customers: in the demo, in onboarding, and inside the AI itself.

When you join Legartis, you don't just take a job, you take ownership. We are a team of product builders and legal experts. We don't chase hype; we build substance.


Your mission

This is not a classic legal role, and not a classic sales or product role. You operate at the intersection of Law, Revenue, and AI, where you are a lever, not a bottleneck: your job is to build the demos, playbooks, and standards that let the whole company scale, and to step into the calls where your expertise closes the gap.

1. Commercial impact. You help win and grow customers. You build and run demos that create a "wow" moment, join high-stakes prospect calls as the legal expert who speaks at eye level with GCs, and run our trials and workshops: onboarding sessions where customers solve their own use cases live, with you coaching. You turn objections into use cases and interest into next steps, and you enable our Sales team to tell the legal story without you in the room. You think of outcomes in terms of trial-to-signature conversion, adoption, expansion.

2. Customer transformation. Once a deal is signed, you make the value real by acting as a strategic sparring partner in onboarding: defining review requirements, tuning playbooks and prompts, and showing legal teams where Legartis delivers the highest ROI. You turn individual learnings into scalable standards and documentation.

3. Making the AI better. You work hands-on with the Legal Agent: prompting, testing, diagnosing where it breaks and why. You feed what you learn from customers back into Product and Engineering (playbook quality, test sets, edge cases) so the product improves with every customer.

4. Internal legal support. You don't just sell the tool; you use it. When necessary, you support Legartis as in-house counsel on contract reviews and specific legal questions.


Your profile

We are honest: people who combine all of this are rare. We hire for aptitude and attitude, assess hands-on in a case study, and train the rest side by side, in real customer work.

1. You can sell the product (key). Not in the cold-calling sense, but in the way a great expert sells: by making the customer succeed in front of their own team. Concretely, this means you can (or want to learn to):

  • Run a live demo with confidence including customized, high-stakes demos and recover gracefully when something doesn't land: pull out a better prompt, adjust on the spot, turn a skeptical question into a stronger result.
  • Coach the customer hands-on. In trials and hackathons, the customer drives and you navigate: you get them to enter their own real legal questions, create the first "wow" moment themselves, and build the habits (saved prompts, reusable workflows) that make them stay.
  • Turn objections into use cases. When a customer says "that won't work for us" or "we'll build it ourselves," you respond with a concrete path: a workaround, a workflow, the honest maintenance cost of the alternative. You're straight about limits, because credibility is what closes.
  • Speak at eye level with GCs and legal teams asking sharp discovery questions, translating their friction points into what the product can do, and framing value in their language (ROI, risk, time saved).
  • Always leave with a next step. Trial licenses, a hackathon, a follow-up workshop, a scoped rollout conversation. You instinctively convert interest into momentum, and you remove friction ("we can make that happen") rather than adding process. Ideally you can point to moments where you influenced a deal, a renewal, or an expansion in any prior role.

2. Legal foundation. Solid legal training and hands-on experience with commercial contracts from in-house, law firm, or legal tech. You understand the "why" behind a clause and can teach that logic to an AI and to a customer. A German 2. Staatsexamen is welcome but not required: we explicitly encourage candidates with qualifications from other jurisdictions or non-traditional paths (e.g. law + IT).

3. Hands-on AI builder. You have spent serious time with LLMs, not as a spectator, but pushing them to their limits. You see prompting and evaluation as a craft and enjoy figuring out where AI systems break and how to fix them.

4. Ownership & communication. You can point to things you built, launched, or drove. You are structured enough to run projects with multiple stakeholders, and precise enough to know that a sharp prompt beats a thousand vague instructions. Excellent German and English; other languages are a plus.


Why us?

  • Impact over hype. You define a new discipline at the intersection of law, revenue, and AI. Your work directly shapes how thousands of legal professionals will operate.
  • Leverage, not grind. You build the standards, playbooks, and demos that multiply your expertise across the whole company.
  • We invest in you. Structured training on the Legal Agent, side-by-side customer calls, and a clear growth path — we build the capability the market doesn't have yet.
  • True ownership. Competitive salary and employee stock options (ESOP).
  • Offices in Berlin, Leipzig, and Zurich with a flexible hybrid setup, plus apéros, lunches, and hiking trips.


Process

  1. Get to know each other: a chat with our People & Operations Manager.
  2. Deep dive with our General Counsel & Head of Legal AI into Legal Engineering at Legartis.
  3. Case study: real tasks at the crossroads of legal thinking, AI prompting, and making the commercial case to a customer.
  4. Meet the team in our Zurich office.
  5. Mutual decision, and we welcome you on board.

jobs.description:
Specialty Insurance Underwriter/Coverage Attorney/Consultant/Professional (Contract)

Our Mission

Rebuild how the world works, to make institutions work better for the people they serve.

About Brain Co.

Brain Co. builds AI-native operating systems for large, regulated institutions. Each system is built for a specific industry, powered by agents that push real workflows forward. Underneath it all is Atlas, our proprietary platform that keeps customers in control, secure by design, and never locked into one model.

Why Now

Brain Co. is entering its next phase of production deployments on a national scale with an elite team built from Palantir, Google, Meta, and Nvidia, and a growing footprint across government, insurance, health, and financial services.

Joining now means shaping both the company and a new category of applied AI. Every project here ships to production and is expected to create measurable customer value and impact.

You'll work alongside exceptional peers on some of the hardest problems in applied AI. It’s the kind of work you'll still be proud of in ten years from now.

Brain Co is applying frontier AI to specialty insurance. We are building AI that reads specialty insurance policies — declarations, forms, endorsements, schedules of underlying, layered programs — and turns them into structured, decision-ready data. We need experienced specialty insurance underwriters/coverage attorneys/consultants/professionals to help us do it right.

You will work directly with our engineering team: telling us where our AI falls short, annotating insurance documents, reviewing AI-generated output, and helping us build the rubrics and benchmarks that define quality for our machine learning pipelines. Your expertise shapes the product so it reflects how specialty insurance is actually practiced.

We are looking for someone who can commit approximately 2–10 hours per week for an initial 3–4 months, with the opportunity to extend based on mutual interest and project needs.

• . Locate and annotate the limits structure within a given excess policy — limits, sublimits, retentions, attachment points, and how the layers stack.

• . Given an insuring agreement and its ensuing exclusions, produce a structured conclusion about how coverage responds to a described scenario.

• . Review AI-generated output, fix mislabeled data, and grade agent performance against what a seasoned practitioner would conclude.

• . Resolve the ambiguous, conflicting, and unusual situations — manuscript wordings, follow-form excess, nested exclusions, schedule-of-underlying disputes, implicit market conventions — that determine whether a product is trusted by real practitioners.

• . Partner with our team to design the scoring criteria and review workflows that tell us, line by line, whether an extraction or a coverage conclusion is accurate.

• . Help us decide how coverage should be interpreted and presented — what a practitioner needs to see, in what structure, and what would mislead them. Translate practice into product requirements.

• . Sit between the documents and the engineers: explain terminology, market convention, and the "why" behind how things are done, and flag where our assumptions do not match reality across lines of business.

• . Review real policies, endorsements, and claims documents and tell us the correct answer — coverages, limits, sublimits, retentions, attachment points, exclusion logic, and how layers stack — so we can measure and improve the AI against an expert standard.

• USA-based. 3 years of experience minimum; 5+ years strongly preferred, specifically within excess and specialty insurance.

• Experience in excess and specialty (E&S) insurance as an underwriter, coverage attorney or counsel, or consultant.

'

• Have deep, hands-on experience in specialty insurance – underwriting, claims, broking, or coverage counsel — and/or broad multiline experience across the lines we work in (General Liability, Professional Liability, and related casualty and specialty lines).

• Can read a policy end-to-end — declarations, forms, endorsements, schedules of underlying — and explain precisely how coverage responds, including across primary and excess layers.

• Have strong opinions on what "correct" means and can articulate the reasoning, not just the verdict, so it can be encoded into an AI system.

• Communicate clearly with non-insurance experts and enjoy the back-and-forth of teaching engineers your craft.

• No technical background required - your job is to tell us if the AI gets it right, not to explain how it works

• Claims experience — working as, or closely alongside, claim adjusters, claim examiners, complex or litigated claims specialists, or claims counsel.

&

• Part-time, contract engagement with flexible scheduling that fits your current work.

• Competitive hourly rate commensurate with experience and depth of expertise.

• Remote-friendly, with collaboration over shared documents and working sessions with our AI and product teams.

Global Specialized Domain Expert Recruiter (Contractor)

Shape the Future of AI

At Labelbox, we're building the critical infrastructure that powers breakthrough AI models at leading research labs and enterprises. Since 2018, we've been pioneering data-centric approaches that are fundamental to AI development, and our work becomes even more essential as AI capabilities expand exponentially.

About Labelbox

We're the only company offering three integrated solutions for frontier AI development:

  1. Enterprise Platform & Tools: Advanced annotation tools, workflow automation, and quality control systems that enable teams to produce high-quality training data at scale
  2. Frontier Data Labeling Service: Specialized data labeling through Alignerr, leveraging subject matter experts for next-generation AI models

Why Join Us

  • Technical Excellence: Work at the cutting edge of AI development, collaborating with industry leaders and shaping the future of artificial intelligence.
  • Innovation at Speed: We celebrate those who take ownership, move fast, and deliver impact. Our environment rewards high agency and rapid execution.
  • Continuous Growth: Every role requires continuous learning and evolution. You'll be surrounded by curious minds solving complex problems at the frontier of AI.
  • Clear Ownership: You'll know exactly what you're responsible for and have the autonomy to execute. We empower people to drive results through clear ownership and metrics.

Organization: Labelbox / Alignerr

Location: Fully remote: Open to recruiters based in Latin America, Mexico, Europe, and beyond

About the role

What if your recruiting expertise could help connect the world's leading experts to some of today's most advanced technology initiatives?

Labelbox powers Alignerr, a network of world-class subject matter experts who contribute their expertise to help develop, evaluate, and improve cutting-edge AI systems. We're looking for driven outbound recruiters to identify and engage highly specialized professionals for our highest-priority projects.

Your mission is to find exceptional domain experts (PhDs, researchers, academics, and senior industry practitioners) in fields like scientific computing, cybersecurity, finance, engineering, mathematics, and other specialized disciplines. These experts apply their knowledge to create high-quality evaluations, verification tasks, and domain-specific training environments that improve the capabilities of next-generation AI models.

This isn't volume recruiting. It's precision hunting for the best minds in the world, on behalf of the projects that matter most. And you're paid for outcomes: every placement earns you a commission, with no ceiling on what you can make.

Who you are

  • Skilled at outbound sourcing through LinkedIn, academic institutions, research communities, professional associations, GitHub, conferences, and other niche networks.
  • Comfortable identifying and engaging senior-level professionals, including PhDs, researchers, faculty, and industry experts.
  • Self-motivated, organized, and driven by performance-based compensation.
  • Excellent written communication skills with the ability to engage professionals across cultures and time zones.
  • Based in Latin America, Mexico, Europe, or a comparable region and able to work fully remotely.
  • No prior AI recruiting experience required, we'll provide the context you need.

Signals you’ll stand out

  • Experience recruiting research, academic, scientific, engineering, healthcare, legal, cybersecurity, quantitative finance, or other specialized talent.
  • Demonstrated success sourcing PhDs, researchers, or other difficult-to-reach expert populations.
  • Experience working in agency recruiting, executive search, or commission-based recruiting environments.
  • Some familiarity with AI, reinforcement learning, or data annotation workflows is helpful but not required.

Why join us

  • Uncapped, performance-based earnings with commission for every successful placement.
  • Flexible, fully remote work with complete control over your schedule.
  • Recruit world-class experts whose knowledge helps advance cutting-edge AI technology.
  • Access a consistent pipeline of specialized recruiting opportunities across diverse technical disciplines.
  • Join a long-term opportunity with a rapidly growing organization as Alignerr continues to expand.

Life at Labelbox

  • Environment: Fast-paced and high-intensity, perfect for ambitious individuals who thrive on ownership and quick decision-making
  • Growth: Career advancement opportunities directly tied to your impact
  • Vision: Be part of building the foundation for humanity's most transformative technology

Our Vision

We believe data will remain crucial in achieving artificial general intelligence. As AI models become more sophisticated, the need for high-quality, specialized training data will only grow. Join us in developing new products and services that enable the next generation of AI breakthroughs.

Labelbox is backed by leading investors including SoftBank, Andreessen Horowitz, B Capital, Gradient Ventures, Databricks Ventures, and Kleiner Perkins. Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading AI labs.

Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu, founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences.

Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta.

About the role:

As a founding Strategic Sales Director for Iberia, you will own 8-12 of the largest strategic accounts across Spain and/or Portugal — IBEX35-caliber banking, telco, insurance, utilities, and travel enterprises. You'll run complex, multi-level sales cycles from 6 to 18 months, build both the business case and the technical win alongside your Solutions Consultant, and drive long-term land-and-expand strategy while continuing to bring in new logos.

As part of the founding Iberia team, you'll work alongside a 10-person Madrid-based org (SDR, SC, and Customer Success) and help shape the region's go-to-market strategy from the ground up.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage a portfolio of 8-12 top strategic accounts in Spain and/or Portugal
  • Generate your own pipeline — Cresta drives strong inbound, but Strategic AEs are expected to self-source roughly 50% of pipeline
  • Orchestrate complex, multi-level sales cycles (6-18 months) across buying committees, procurement, legal, and security
  • Build the business case and the technical win in partnership with your Solutions Consultant and extended team
  • Drive land-and-expand strategy with a long-term vision for each account, while continuing to prioritize new-logo acquisition
  • Partner closely with Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and Engineering to deliver an exceptional customer experience

Qualifications We Value:

  • 8+ years of enterprise SaaS sales experience, including at least 4 years as a quota-carrying individual contributor selling into large Spanish enterprises (IBEX35 or equivalent: banking, telco, insurance, utilities, travel)
  • Verified track record closing deals of €500K+ ARR / €1M+ TCV, including at least one deal exceeding €1M TCV at an IBEX35-caliber account
  • New-logo hunting as your primary motion — majority of attainment historically from net-new logos rather than installed-base expansion
  • Experience navigating complex 6-18 month cycles, including RFPs, buying committees, and procurement/legal/security review in regulated industries
  • Existing C-level/VP network within Spanish enterprise accounts

Nice-to-Have:

  • CX / contact center / conversational AI domain exposure (CCaaS, WEM, analytics, virtual agents)
  • Experience opening a market or territory from zero for a hyper-growth vendor
  • Experience co-selling with SIs and channel partners (e.g. Accenture, Telefónica Tech, Sabio-type ecosystem)
  • Familiarity with Ley SAC and Spanish regulatory drivers in customer service
  • MEDDPICC (or equivalent) formally trained

Language & Travel:

  • Native or negotiation-grade Spanish, fluent English; Portuguese is a strong plus
  • Madrid-based, with travel across the Iberian Peninsula expected

Perks & Benefits:

We offer a comprehensive and people-first benefits package to support you at work and in life:

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with plans to fit you and your family
  • Flexible PTO to take the time you need, when you need it
  • Paid parental leave for all new parents welcoming a new child
  • Remote work setup budget to help you create a productive home office
  • Monthly wellness and communication stipend to keep you connected and balanced

Compensation at Cresta

Cresta’s approach to compensation is simple: recognize impact, reward excellence, and invest in our people. We offer competitive, location-based pay that reflects the market and what each individual brings to the table.

The posted base salary range represents what we expect to pay for this role in a given location. Final offers are shaped by factors like experience, skills, education, and geography. In addition to base pay, total compensation includes equity and a comprehensive benefits package for you and your family.

This role is variable target compensation eligible. There is potential to exceed target earnings when goals are surpassed.

jobs.title: Manager Amazon
jobs.description:
Manager Amazon

Über uns

Kijimea – Aus der Forschung. Für Dein Leben. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2011 verfolgen wir eine klare Vision: Wir möchten das Potenzial der Mikrobiota (Bakterien) in unserem Darm gezielt nutzen für ein längeres und gesünderes Leben - für alle Menschen.

Ein erster großer Meilenstein auf diesem Weg gelang uns bereits 2013 mit der Entdeckung und klinischen Erforschung des einzigartigen Bakterienstamms B. bifidum MIMBb75 (Kijimea Reizdarm). Seitdem konnten wir das Leben von Millionen Reizdarmpatienten weltweit spürbar verbessern. Heute gehört B. bifidum MIMBb75 zu den am besten erforschten Bakterienstämmen weltweit. Seine Wirksamkeit und sein einzigartiger Wirkmechanismus wurden in zahlreichen klinischen Studien nachgewiesen und publiziert – u.a. in renommierten Fachzeitschriften wie The Lancet.

Wir arbeiten mit führenden Forschungsinstitutionen wie der Charité Berlin zusammen, um die Zusammenhänge zwischen der Mikrobiota (Bakterien in unserem Darm) und Allergien, Hautkrankheiten und psychischen Störungen zu erforschen. Kurz gesagt: Wir untersuchen, wie die Bakterien in unserem Darm Einfluss auf ein längeres und gesünderes Leben nehmen.

Heute zählen wir zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare-Unternehmen weltweit. Unsere Kunden erreichen wir über verschiedenste Kanäle: über die direkte Kommunikation mit Ärzten und Apothekern sowie Print-, TV- und Digitalmarketing. Um unser stark wachsendes Geschäft in Europa weiter auszubauen, suchen wir herausragende Talente, die uns bei dieser Mission unterstützen. Unser Ziel ist klar definiert: Bis 2028 wollen wir Kijimea zur weltweit größten DTC-Probiotikamarke machen und damit jährlich über 50 Millionen Menschen ein besseres Leben schenken.

Für Dich klingt das spannend? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.

Deine Mission bei uns

Möchtest Du den Erfolg unserer Gesundheitsmarken auf Amazon mitgestalten und mit kreativen, datenbasierten Lösungen neue Maßstäbe setzen? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig!

Als Manager Amazon verantwortest Du unseren Amazon-Vertriebskanal ganzheitlich und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Healthcare-Produkte sichtbar, verfügbar und erfolgreich sind. Hilf uns dabei, Millionen von Menschen ein längeres und gesünderes Leben zu ermöglichen.

 

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst einen einheitlichen, überzeugenden und performanceorientierten Markenauftritt auf unseren Product Detail Pages (PDPs) sowie in unseren Amazon-Werbeanzeigen.

  • Du koordinierst und setzt die Ausspielung unserer Amazon-Werbekampagnen gemeinsam mit dem Online-Marketing-Team um und fungierst als Sparringspartner, um eine optimale Kampagnen- und Umsatzperformance sicherzustellen.

  • Du erstellst regelmäßige Reportings zu Umsatz, Marktanteilen und Kampagnenperformance und leitest daraus konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ab.

  • Du planst in enger Abstimmung mit unserem Logistikteam die Lagerbestände bei Amazon und sorgst für eine zuverlässige Produktverfügbarkeit.

  • Du bist der zentrale Ansprechpartner für unsere Key Accounts bei Amazon und löst operative Probleme wie Produktsperrungen mit kreativen und effizienten Lösungsansätzen.

  • Du beobachtest Wettbewerber, Markttrends und Amazon-Richtlinienänderungen und leitest daraus Optimierungspotenziale für unseren Kanal ab.

  • Du behältst die Kundenzufriedenheit im Blick, analysierst Bewertungen, erkennst Trends frühzeitig und stimmst Dich bei Kundenanfragen eng mit unserem Kundenservice ab.

  • Du bist intern die erste Anlaufstelle für Amazon-spezifische Fragen und arbeitest dich schnell und eigenständig in buchhalterische sowie rechtliche Themen ein.

 

Dein Profil

jobs.title: Data Delivery Engineer
jobs.description:
Data Delivery Engineer

The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century.

MicroAGI is building it. We are the data layer for physical AI.

Every customer needs data delivered in a slightly different shape. Your job is to be the last-mile delivery layer: take what the internal team has prepared, transform it into the required customer format, and make a messy process look effortless from the outside.

What You Will Do

  • Transform prepared data into the exact format each customer needs.

  • Gather and consolidate customer requirements into reusable modules, checklists, and workflows that the team can run again.

  • Sit between the internal team and the customer as the delivery layer for data outputs.

  • Coordinate fixes when something goes wrong, and communicate clearly with the customer at a lightweight Slack-level of interaction.

  • Follow the existing documented delivery process step by step, then make it easier to run over time.

  • Build internal tools that both technical and operations teams can use to make data delivery faster, clearer, and less manual.

  • Use AI tools heavily as part of the day-to-day work.

Requirements

  • Smart generalist with clear, simple algorithmic thinking. You do not need to be a deep technical specialist.

  • Obsessive attention to detail. The job is won or lost on small mistakes.

  • Fast learner. Every customer has different requirements, and you will need to adapt quickly.

  • Comfortable turning messy, complex processes into something that looks clean and reliable from the outside.

  • Comfortable with basic customer communication when something needs to be clarified or fixed.

  • High agency - you don't wait to be told what to do.

  • Fluent in English.

jobs.title: AI Enablement Consultant (m/w/d)
jobs.description:

Deine Rolle

Den Großteil deiner Zeit verbringst du in Trainings und Workshops bei unseren Kund:innen. Dabei entstehen Listen an Pain Points sowie potenzielle Use Cases, von denen du di vielversprechendsten in unsere Discovery Sprints bringst. Das sind kurze, intensive Formate, in denen wir mit Fachbereichen herausfinden, wo AI den größten Hebel hat.

Ob deine Arbeit wirkt, siehst du daran, wie viele Teams nach dem Training dranbleiben und wie viele Projekte daraus wachsen. Enablement ist ein neuer Bereich bei uns, und du gestaltest ihn von Anfang an mit.

Aufgaben

  • Du gibst Trainings und Workshops, in denen Teams AI selbst ausprobieren und erste Anwendungen bauen.

  • Aus Trainings und Gesprächen sammelst du Use Cases und bewertest sie nach Nutzen und Machbarkeit. Manche schafft ein Team allein, andere brauchen ein größeres Projekt mit uns.
  • In Discovery Sprints moderierst du Workshops und führst Interviews mit Fachbereichen, Führungskräften und den Menschen, die täglich mit dem Prozess arbeiten.
  • Mit Fachbereichsleitungen und Geschäftsführung sprichst du auf Augenhöhe und erkennst früh, wo ein Folgeprojekt sinnvoll ist.
  • Angebote, Methoden und Vorlagen für den Bereich Enablement baust du mit auf.

Qualifikation

  • Moderation und Interviews liegen dir: Du hörst zu, fragst nach und fasst so zusammen, dass Entscheidungen möglich werden.

NOCH FRAGEN?

Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht und helfen dir gerne weiter!

  • EGYM Wellpass: Mit uns bleibst du fit & wir bringen dich deutschlandweit in die angesagtesten Fitness- und Wellnessstudios

ÜBER UNS

Unsere Mission ist es, frisches, gesundes und vor allem leckeres Essen überall dort anzubieten, wo Menschen den Großteil ihres Alltags verbringen – in Büros, ganz gleich, ob im Gewerbegebiet oder mitten in der Stadt, während langer Schichten im Krankenhaus oder in den Tiefen einer Produktionshalle, in der rund um die Uhr Menschen arbeiten. Überall bieten wir vollwertige Gerichte, Snacks und Getränke genau dort an, wo und wann du sie brauchst.

Proprietäre Technologien, selbstlernende Algorithmen und effiziente Lieferketten helfen uns dabei, das Paradox zwischen frischem Essen, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit aufzulösen. Mit unserer eigens entwickelten Technologieplattform optimieren wir die Mengenplanung und sagen Food Waste den Kampf an. Wir wollen einen positiven Effekt erzielen – auf die Umwelt, den Alltag unserer Kund:innen und unsere Communities. Deshalb spenden wir übrig gebliebene Gerichte an Foodsharing und andere soziale Initiativen direkt vor unserer Haustür.

Als Marktführer versorgen wir mit Foodji bereits täglich Tausende Menschen in ganz Deutschland. Zu unseren Kund:innen zählen unter anderem der Münchner Flughafen, Klarna, Enpal und Wingcopter.
