About Cortea

We're Cortea, a European audit-tech company, born in Berlin, rebuilding how audits are done everywhere.

Audits are still driven by spreadsheets, checklists, and manual reviews in one of the most regulated, high-stakes areas of business. We use AI to automate audits end to end, so highly educated auditors no longer spend 60+ hour weeks on manual work and can focus on judgment, trust, and choices that matter.

With €15m+ in funding, a live product, and paying customers across Europe, we're at a stage where your choices will directly shape Cortea's future, and how audits are done.

The Role

This is a role for an experienced auditor who enjoys the client side of the profession: building relationships, leading discussions, and earning the trust of sceptical practitioners. As part of Cortea's UK go-to-market team, you are the subject-matter expert who gives our commercial work credibility: you speak with auditors as a peer, lead methodology conversations with prospects and customers, and help turn pilots into long-term partnerships. Colleagues own the sales playbook, forecasting, and deal mechanics, while you own trust, expertise, and account growth.

Industry Voice: Build a visible public presence for Cortea: be active on LinkedIn, speak at industry events, and evangelise AI-supported auditing to the UK profession

Head of Formal Verification (m/f/d)
Your mission

You own the direction of our formal verification business. Our managers keep delivery predictable. You decide what the organisation becomes.

You report to the CEO and are a member of the executive leadership team. You carry the FV consulting business as a whole — where it goes, how it performs, who leads it — and you answer for it. You will not solve verification problems, and you will rarely run a project or an account yourself. Concretely, you own:

  • Direction. The roadmap for FV consulting. Which capabilities, markets and problem domains we pursue, and what we decline.
  • Customers. You are the face of LUBIS EDA to our key accounts and at executive level. You open the doors your managers cannot, and you carry the conversations that decide a long-term relationship.
  • Organisation. Structure, standards, playbooks, talent pipelines, and the career framework in practice. You keep improving how we work, and you decide when a new technology — AI among them — changes the way we deliver.
  • Leaders. Our Verification Managers report to you. You hire them, develop them, and grow the bench behind them. This is the main measure of the role.
  • Quality. Holding the quality bar under commercial pressure. Our entire positioning depends on it.
  • Product interface. What our engineers learn on customer projects is the best input our software roadmap gets.


Your profile

You have developed leaders, not "only" engineers. You have set direction where there was no precedent, made the calls, and carried an organisation with you. You build systems that outlast your attention.

You need credibility in formal verification. Not to overrule your senior engineers. You need it to make the calls only you can make: is a capability gap real, is a quality standard achievable at the price we quote, does a bet on a new formal domain hold.

YOUR EXPERIENCE

  • 12+ years in semiconductor verification, EDA or adjacent engineering services.
  • 5+ years in leadership, including managers reporting to you.
  • Fluent in formal methods and their trade-offs. Credible with a customer’s engineering leadership and on a conference stage.
  • You know how technical services are priced and defended on quality rather than volume.
  • Nice-to-have: you have scaled a technical organisation past start-up stage, where the systems had to be built.


Why us?

LUBIS is growing, and we’re looking for a Head of Formal Verification.

This is one of those roles where you don’t just join an organisation. You help build it.

Our formal sign-off business is growing. Our customers are getting bigger. So are our ambitions. We’re looking for someone who wants real ownership of what comes next: how we develop our people, how we deliver outstanding projects, how we work with our customers, and what world-class technical consulting at LUBIS should look like.

You’ll work directly with our leadership team. You’ll have the freedom to shape structures and standards. You’ll build an organisation around some of the strongest formal verification expertise in the market.

We’re not looking for someone to maintain what already exists. We’re looking for someone who gets excited about making it better, bigger and more professional.

If you want a leadership role with real influence, and the chance to build something you’ll be proud of, come build it with us.

Product Marketing Manager in Legal Tech (Zurich)
Description

Legal AI content is turning into a commodity. Every vendor ships the same AI-generated blog posts and the same generic battlecards. We are transitioning into an AI-native company ourselves, and that changes what this role has to be. You would sit in the marketing department with a dotted line to the product department, but not as a traditional product marketer who ships a few blog posts and calls it enablement. Not as a pure thinker who never touches a sales deck. Instead, as one person who owns our voice and turns it into everything the company needs to win: the thesis that gets us cited, the sales slide that closes next week’s deal, and the briefing that gets a General Counsel to say yes.

You will use AI tooling and agents to cover ground that used to take a small team, so you can spend your own time on the part that cannot be delegated: the thinking, the judgment, and the writing that actually changes someone’s mind.


Your mission

1. Product Marketing & Market Intelligence 

  • Drive go-to-market impact for launches and expansion, from plan to execution.

  • Own deep knowledge of our ICP and competitive landscape, and feed it back into the product and sales strategy.

  • Bring market and customer truth back to Product so we build what actually matters.

  • Work across Product, Marketing, Sales and leadership. You don’t sit in a silo.

2. Positioning, Narrative & Thought Leadership 

  • Own positioning: define what Legartis stands for, against which alternatives, for which buyer.

  • Develop and defend clear, evidence-backed points of view on where Legal AI is going. Not generic AI-created opinions, but real positions based on customer and buyer research (interviews with General Counsel, CFOs, legal operations leaders).

  • Conceive flagship studies and thought leadership content. Direct AI tools to help you scale production while you own the substance and the voice.

  • Own our thought leadership channels, including video, and decide what gets said. Write what can’t be delegated: founder posts, executive bylines, keynote scripts, board-level memos.

3. Sales & Customer-Facing Enablement 

  • Build the sales slides, briefings, one-pagers and competitive battlecards that make Sales and Customer Success more effective in every conversation.

  • Translate positioning and research into materials for specific deals, verticals and executive-level conversations.

  • Work directly with Sales and CS to find out what’s missing in the field. Build case studies and customer proof points that Sales actually uses, not ones that sit in a folder.

What We Want to Achieve Together

In 6 months: a flagship study that gets cited by competitors and customers. Sales armed with materials that actually get used in deals. A clear Legartis position that everyone in the company can repeat in 30 seconds.

In 12 months: Legartis recognized as one of the leading European voices on Legal AI, with a content and enablement engine, you plus the AI tools you direct, that outproduces companies with five times the headcount.


Your profile

  • Proven strategist: demonstrated success creating and executing marketing strategies.

  • Storyteller: you craft compelling materials about complex AI products for non-technical audiences.

  • Clear communicator: exceptional written and verbal communication with a strong visual sensibility.

  • Impact-driven: comfortable with experimentation and interpreting both quantitative and qualitative data.

  • AI-savvy: crafty with AI tools and automations — you use them daily and keep exploring what's new.

  • A track record where writing and thinking were central: journalism, industry or analyst research, strategy consulting, or senior product marketing with real strategic ownership. 4+ years in marketing, product marketing or a comparable strategic role at a SaaS company. Classic PMM experience (positioning, GTM, enablement) is a strong plus, not a hard requirement, if your thinking and writing are strong enough.

  • Fluent German and English, executive-level writing in both.


Why us?

  • Real editorial ownership over our voice and our position, not a content calendar handed down from someone else.

  • A platform to build your own visible profile as a voice in Legal AI.

  • Modern office in Leipzig or Berlin, hybrid setup, with regular presence in Zürich and team events such as hiking, dinners and offsites.

  • Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) participation.

  • Competitive salary, based on experience and seniority.


Process

  1. 30 min with our People & Operations Manager: cultural fit, understanding the role and your expectations.

  2. Positioning conversation with our Head of Product: bring a point of view on Legal AI and be ready to defend it live.

  3. Case study: show us something you’ve written or built, and how you’d turn it into a sales-ready asset.

  4. Meet the team in the office.

  5. Decision: if it’s mutual, we welcome you to the team!

How to Apply

Send us your CV, two or three writing or work samples you’re proud of, and a short note answering: what’s your sharpest point of view on where Legal AI is heading, and what’s the evidence?

jobs.title: Sales Representative (m/w/d) Quereinstieg - Basel
jobs.description:
Sales Representative (m/w/d) Quereinstieg - Basel

Du hast noch nie im B2B-Vertrieb gearbeitet, möchtest aber gerne alle wichtigen Werkzeuge erlernen, um so richtig durchzustarten? Bei Salonkee lernst du den Vertrieb von Grund auf kennen und baust dir in Basel dein eigenes Netzwerk auf.

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software – von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70 % weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche.

Deine Rolle

  • Du verantwortest das Wachstum in deiner Region und bist die zentrale Ansprechperson vor Ort

  • Du gehst aktiv auf Saloninhaber:innen in deiner Region zu – telefonisch, per Walk-in oder über Social Media (Kaltakquise).

  • Vor Ort ermittelst du den Bedarf des Salons mithilfe von Fragen und zeigst anhand von Produktdemos, wie Salonkee den Alltag vereinfachen kann.

  • Du verantwortest deinen eigenen Funnel vom Erstkontakt bis zum Abschluss.

  • Deine Woche planst du eigenverantwortlich, mit klaren Zielen und einer Führungskraft, die dich unterstützt und weiterentwickelt.

Das bringst du mit

  • Vertriebserfahrung ist nicht unbedingt notwendig. Wenn du aus dem Hospitality, Beauty, Retail, Fitness, Event oder einem anderen Bereich mit viel Kundenkontakt kommst, bringst du das Wichtigste schon mit.

  • Du bist kontaktfreudig und gehst gerne in den Austausch – egal ob am Telefon oder direkt vor Ort.

  • Du bist in der Lage, Menschen zu begeistern und Interessen zu wecken.

  • Du kannst mit Ablehnung umgehen und richtest den Blick nach vorn.

  • Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln.

  • Du bist strukturiert, organisiert und sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

  • Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

  • Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

Das erwartet dich bei uns

  • Vertrieb von Grund auf lernen: Bootcamp zum Start, gezieltes Ramp-Up Programm, Shadowing bei erfahrenen Kolleg:innen, Roleplays und regelmäßiges Coaching.

  • Ein Team vor Ort: Team Lead und Kolleg:innen in deiner Region – du startest nicht allein.

  • Ein klarer Entwicklungspfad: von Junior über Senior bis hin zu Führungsrollen.

  • Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

  • Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

  • Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

  • 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

  • Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision.

  • Teamevents, die ihren Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Teamformate.

Wie geht es weiter?

  1. Bewerbung & Sichtung – wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

  2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30–45 Minuten).

  3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

  4. Field Day – zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.

jobs.title: Bookkeeper (Founding Member)
jobs.description:
Bookkeeper (Founding Member)

Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

About This Role

We're hiring the first Bookkeepers on our Financial Management team — a founding, hands-on role at the intersection of real client bookkeeping and 0-to-1 product building. You won't be joining an established practice with a mature playbook; you'll be writing it. You'll do the actual books for our earliest restaurant customers while working shoulder-to-shoulder with product and engineering to shape the service, tooling, and workflows that will define how Toast delivers bookkeeping at scale.

This role is for someone who genuinely likes restaurant bookkeeping — the prime cost, the tip reporting, the multi-location chaos — and who also gets energy from questioning industry norms and building something new rather than maintaining something established. Ambiguity here isn't a bug; for the first year or two, it's the job.

If you're the kind of person who reads a messy set of restaurant books and sees an interesting puzzle — and who'd rather build the recipe than follow one — we'd love to hear from you.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

  • Own end-to-end bookkeeping for a portfolio of pilot restaurant customers: chart of accounts setup, monthly close, bank/POS reconciliations, accruals, and delivery of clean financial statements.
  • Serve as Toast's in-house expert on restaurant-specific accounting — prime cost, COGS, labor and tip reporting, multi-unit consolidation, high-volume daily transaction reconciliation, and multi-jurisdiction sales tax.
  • Embed directly with product and engineering, translating real client workflows and pain points into product requirements that shape our roadmap — you'll be in the room when we decide what to build next, not just told what shipped.
  • Design and document the SOPs, controls, and QA processes a bookkeeping function needs to run reliably — since none of it exists yet, you'll build the foundation others will scale on.
  • Work directly with restaurant operators to understand their businesses, set expectations, and deliver a service that earns their trust.
  • Help define what “great” looks like for this function as it grows, including future hiring needs, tooling choices, and where automation should (and shouldn't) replace judgment.
  • Move fluidly between hands-on bookkeeping work and higher-leverage building work as priorities shift — comfort wearing both hats is essential.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • 5+years of bookkeeping experience, with meaningful time spent on restaurant or hospitality clients specifically.
  • Deep working knowledge of restaurant accounting mechanics: COGS and prime cost, tip pooling and reporting, multi-location consolidation, and reconciling high-volume POS transaction data.
  • Fluency with modern bookkeeping and accounting software, and genuine enthusiasm for adopting new tools.
  • Experience building a process or practice from scratch.
  • Genuine comfort with ambiguity and undefined scope; you'd rather help define a role than be handed a finished one.
  • Strong communication skills — able to translate accounting complexity into plain language for both restaurant operators and internal product/engineering partners.
  • Sharp attention to detail and the organizational discipline to manage multiple clients' books accurately and on schedule.

What will help you stand out (Nonessential Skills/Nice to Haves)

  • Experience at a tech startup, in professional services, or inside an embedded finance / fintech environment.
  • Prior exposure to Toast POS or other restaurant management systems.
  • Experience working with AI tools (ie - Claude, GPT, Gemini, etc.)
  • A CPA, CB, or equivalent bookkeeping/accounting credential.

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.

Our Total Rewards Philosophy

We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https://careers.toasttab.com/toast-benefits.

The base salary range for this role is listed below. The starting salary will be determined based on skills, experience, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, our total rewards components include cash compensation (overtime, bonus/commissions if eligible), equity, and benefits. You can learn more about how we align pay with local labor markets in our Geographic Pay Zone Philosophy.

Zone A

$91,000—$146,000 USD

Zone B

$79,000—$126,000 USD

Zone C

$72,000—$115,000 USD

How Toast Uses AI in its Hiring Process

Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people. We ask that you complete interviews and assessments on your own, without real-time AI tools, recording, or transcription bots, unless we tell you otherwise in advance. To learn more: https://careers.toasttab.com/ai-in-hiring

Our Approach to Hybrid Working

We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. Please visit the Locations page on our career site to learn more about our in-office expectations by region: https://careers.toasttab.com/locations-toast

People Are the Secret Ingredient in Our Recipe for Success

At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient—when they thrive, we thrive. The restaurant industry brings together people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we value that same breadth at Toast. We strive to build a culture grounded in authenticity, respect, and humility, where every Toaster has a real opportunity to grow, contribute, and do their best work—raising the bar in delivering exceptional experiences for our customers and each other.

We Thrive Together

We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst, GTM Analytics - CANADA
jobs.description:
Senior Data Analyst, GTM Analytics - CANADA

Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

Why This Role Matters

Our GTM Analytics team owns the metrics that run the business for Sales, Marketing, and Client Success. We're past the phase of standing up basic reporting — we're now building a modern, agentic analytics practice, including Lighthouse, our internal BI-as-code platform, where dashboards, metrics, and semantic definitions live in version-controlled code rather than scattered across disconnected tools.

This role is a chance to shape that next chapter. You'll partner directly with Sales, Marketing, and CS leaders to answer their hardest questions about pipeline, funnel conversion, campaign performance, and retention, while helping build the infrastructure and AI-forward workflows that let the whole GTM org get trustworthy answers faster.

You'll report to our Senior Manager of Analytics and work in tight, two-week sprints alongside Analytics Engineering, so you'll see your work ship and get used — fast.

What You'll Do

GTM Analysis & Decision Support

  • Deliver decision-ready analysis across Sales, Marketing, and Client Success: pipeline health, funnel conversion, campaign and channel performance, cohort/retention, and GRR/NRR drivers.

  • Partner directly with Sales, Marketing, and CSM stakeholders to scope questions, frame recommendations, and see analysis through to a decision — not just a dashboard handoff.

  • Bring structure to ambiguous asks — translate a stakeholder's question into a clear, testable analytical approach.

Data Modeling & Quality

  • Build and maintain dbt models and marts for Sales, Marketing, and CS domains, with Salesforce as a core source system.

  • Own data quality and documentation for your domain: clear definitions, source-of-truth tables, and QA that stakeholders can trust without double-checking.

Lighthouse & Agentic Analytics

  • Contribute to Lighthouse, our BI-as-code platform, as we build it out — help define how dashboards, metrics, and semantic models get written, versioned, and reviewed like software.

  • Note: Lighthouse is an active build, not a finished platform — you'll be shaping it, not just using it.

  • Push our analytics workflows toward agentic AI: using AI agents to accelerate analysis, automate recurring reporting, and cut down on manual, one-off dashboard requests.

  • Bring a point of view on where AI can replace manual analyst work versus where it can't — you should be as comfortable prompting and evaluating an agent as writing the SQL yourself.

How You'll Work

  • Operate in two-week sprints, planning and prioritizing your own backlog against team OKRs alongside your manager.

  • Give clear, proactive status updates to stakeholders rather than waiting to be asked.

What We're Looking For

Experience

  • 5+ years in analytics/BI, with meaningful time supporting Sales, Marketing, or Customer Success functions at a fast-growing company. Staff-level candidates should bring deeper scope — larger or more ambiguous problems owned end-to-end, and a track record of setting technical direction, not just executing against it.

  • Expert SQL and hands-on dbt experience modeling GTM data.

  • Comfortable with Python for analysis and automation — this isn't a heavy ML/stats role, but you know how to script your way out of manual work.

  • Experience with Salesforce as a data source — you understand CRM objects, fields, and the quirks of modeling data.

  • Familiarity with a modern data stack: Fivetran or similar EL tooling, and a cloud warehouse (we run Snowflake; BigQuery experience also welcome).

BI & AI Fluency

  • Experience with at least one modern BI tool (Sigma, Hex, Tableau, Looker, or similar) is a strong plus, not a hard requirement — what matters more is that you understand how modern BI organizations operate: governed semantic layers, self-serve dashboards, and BI-as-code approaches.

  • Genuine curiosity about agentic analytics — you've used AI agents or LLM tools to speed up analysis, and you want to help define what that looks like at scale.

  • We build with Claude day-to-day, so hands-on experience with Claude Code (or a similar coding agent like Codex) is a big plus — you'll use it to move faster on dbt models, scripting, and analysis, not just as a novelty.

Mindset

  • Strong communicator who can frame a recommendation clearly for a non-technical stakeholder and defend it under questioning.

  • Comfortable with the accountability of owning a deliverable through to closure, not just the analysis in the middle.

  • Energized by ambiguity and fast iteration — two-week sprints mean you'll ship early and often.

Compensation

Additional Information

Join us in shaping the future of real estate

The real estate industry is in the midst of a seismic shift, and the future belongs to those who break new ground. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the proptech and marketing sectors, Luxury Presence challenges the status quo of what technology can do for real estate agents, leaders, and brokerages.

We're a team of agile and tenacious innovators working collaboratively to drive the industry forward. Together, we build game-changing products that empower modern real estate entrepreneurs to dominate their markets. From award-winning web design to agile SEO solutions to cutting-edge AI tools, we deliver tech that anticipates market shifts and keeps our clients ahead of their competition.

Founded in 2016 by Stanford Business School alum Malte Kramer, Luxury Presence has grown to a global team ranked on the Inc. 5000 fastest-growing companies list three years in a row. We're backed by world-class investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, NextEquity Partners, Toba Capital, and Switch Ventures, and have raised $89 million to date.

More than 18,000 real estate businesses rely on our platform, including 30% of the Wall Street Journal RealTrends top agents and teams. Additionally, many of the industry's most powerful brokerages rely on Luxury Presence as a trusted business partner.

Every year since 2020, Luxury Presence has ranked on BuiltIn's Best Place to Work lists. HousingWire named our founder and CEO a 2024 Tech Trendsetter, we've received several Tech100 Awards, and we just scored an Inman Innovation Award for Best AI-Powered Platform.

Luxury Presence is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.

We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.

About the role
The AI Outcomes Manager is DevRev's unified post-sales owner — bringing Customer Success and Customer Support together into a single role. Instead of handoffs between siloed teams, you own accounts end-to end: resolving issues, driving adoption, managing escalations, and making sure customers extract measurable value from what they bought.
You manage each account by its health and needs — proactively spotting risk and opportunity — rather than by whether a given interaction is labelled "support" or "success." AI is your multiplier, not a tool you use on the side. Our AI agent handles first-line triage, ticket classification, routing, knowledge retrieval, and deflection — so you can focus on what AI can't do: complex judgment, strategic enablement, relationship building, and
driving outcomes. You'll be measured not just by what you do directly, but by how well you leverage AI to scale across a full portfolio.

What you'll own

Your portfolio — a book of enterprise and growth accounts under single, accountable ownership. The model protects depth over volume.
The customer relationship, end-to-end
— Own accounts from implementation and go-live through adoption, renewal health, and expansion.
— Be the customer's single point of trust — no handoffs, in good times and bad.
— Stay accountable for the outcome even when another team is responsible for the underlying work ("more accountability, less responsibility").

Implementation & go-live
— Align on scope, success criteria, and the value the customer is buying before kickoff. DevRev · Customer Experience — Customer Outcomes 1
— Validate what was sold against what's feasible; close gaps and secure sign-off.
— Own go/no-go readiness — flag risk and hold the line when a launch isn't ready. Ticket lifecycle, powered by AI
— Respond within SLA — AI drafts, you review and personalize.
— Validate and correct AI's classification and severity; your corrections train the model.
— Own tickets through resolution; decide workaround vs. code fix and route to engineering while staying the owner.

Adoption & value
— Track usage trends and flag drops early using AI anomaly signals; turn them into proactive outreach.
— Run enablement sessions; compare entitlements to actual usage and close adoption gaps.
— Translate usage into business value (time saved, cost avoided, deflection); build the roadmap into every business review.

Relationship & commercial
— Keep relationships multi-threaded and engage executive sponsors.
— Act on account signals before the customer raises a problem.
— Run renewal reviews ahead of expiry; source and flag expansion opportunities to Sales.

Who we're looking for
— Technically oriented and AI-capable — comfortable with APIs, tracing issues, and explaining root causes to both engineers and customers.

Qualifications

jobs.description:
Creative Strategist & Producer - Consumer

Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.


Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

 

Kraken’s Consumer Creative & Design team owns end-to-end creative execution for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Our disciplines cover performance ad creative, 2D and 3D design, motion design, AI video creative and web design, turning growth strategy into creative that converts across paid, owned and organic surfaces. We work closely with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content & Social, Lifecycle and our regional leads, holding the line on brand and messaging quality on everything that ships.

 

The opportunity

Great creative starts with a sharp idea, and the earlier it arrives, the better the work gets. As our Creative Strategist & Producer, you bring ideas in at the start of a campaign and you can also make them. Up to half the role is writing complete, concept-led briefs for paid static and motion, and sometimes organic and social, then briefing them into our creatives and designers. The other half is making work yourself, in whatever format you’re strongest at. You also help Product Marketing and Performance Marketing write stronger briefs of their own.

This role is for a proactive self-starter. Nobody will hand you the idea: you go and find it, pitch it and get it made.

You report to the Creative Lead, Consumer Creative & Design, who gives you direction, feedback and cover in reviews. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports. You work daily with Product Marketing and Performance Marketing, who bring deep knowledge of the product and the media channels, and with the creatives who bring your briefs to life.

 

  • Spot opportunities in culture every day. Watch pop culture, trends, competitors, comments and performance data, and turn what you find into ideas we ship the same week. Stay close to financial markets and to Kraken’s audience.

  • Write complete, concept-led briefs for paid static and motion, built with Product Marketing and Performance Marketing, and brief them into the performance creatives and designers.

  • Help Product Marketing and Performance Marketing managers sharpen their own briefs, bringing the concept, the hook and the cultural angle to the start of the process.

  • Pitch original concepts for paid and social before anyone asks, so ideas reach the team already sharp.

  • Make your own content for paid and organic. The format is open: you could be a meme machine, an AI video specialist, someone who performs to camera, or something we haven’t thought of. What matters is that it feels native to the feed and ships fast.

  • Use performance data and social listening as creative input, and get more distinct angles into tests each month.Performance Marketing owns test design and readouts; you own the creative response.

  • React inside the news cycle. You spot the moment, and you brief it or make it yourself.

  • Partner with Product Marketing and compliance to get work approved without losing the idea.

  • Keep your briefs and files clean enough for other people to build on.

 
 

What you bring

  • 5+ years in creative strategy, social, content or performance creative at a high-volume in-house team, brand or agency, ideally in fintech, crypto, gaming or another regulated category.

  • A portfolio submitted with your application. Include two or three concept-led briefs or concept decks, with what shipped and how it performed where you’re able to share it, plus work you made yourself in the formats that are your strength. Include one idea you spotted in culture or data and took to market, with a short note on what the results told you and what you changed.

  • A proactive, self-starting way of working. You find the idea, pitch it and drive it to be shipped without waiting to be asked, and you’re comfortable owning your workflow with light direction.

  • Pop-culture fluency and a chronically online persona, with comedic instinct and a sense for what’s about to feel dated.

  • A performance marketer’s grip on what a good brief needs: a clear objective, audience, hook, platform, format and set of constraints, and the ability to coach others toward it.

  • A creative superpower you can execute on alone, with shipped work to show for it.

  • Platform-native instincts across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit and X. You can explain why the same idea needs a different build on each one.

  • Fluency in the metrics creative moves, and the habit of using performance data and social listening as inputs to ideas.

  • A solid copywriting instinct. Plain language, value first, no hype and no jargon.

  • Comfort working inside regulatory constraints, with concepts that survive risk warnings and market-specific requirements.

  • Speed without sloppiness. Comfortable with fast turnarounds, several review rounds and late changes.

jobs.description:
Senior IC PDK Development Engineer
About The Role and Team

Quantum Motion is a fast-growing quantum computing start-up based in London. We are developing quantum processors based on industrial-grade silicon chips, with the potential to radically transform computing power in areas such as materials modelling, medicine, artificial intelligence, and cybersecurity. We operate out of state-of-the-art cryogenic facilities in Islington and bring together an outstanding interdisciplinary team spanning quantum physics to IC design. 


Our Team

Since 2021 our team has been listed every year in the “Top 100 Startups worth watching” in the EE Times, and our technology breakthroughs have been featured in The Telegraph, BBC, and the New Statesman. Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. Our chairman is the co-founder of Cadence and Synopsys, the two leading companies in the area of Electronic Design Automation. We are backed by a world-class group of investors including Bosch Ventures, Porsche SE, Sony Innovation Fund, Oxford Science Enterprises, INKEF Capital, and Octopus Ventures. 

We bring together the brightest quantum engineers, integrated circuit (IC) engineers, quantum computing theoreticians, and software engineers to create a unique, world-leading team, working closely together to maximize our combined expertise. Our collaborative and interdisciplinary culture is an ideal fit for anyone who thrives in a cutting-edge research and development environment focused on tackling big challenges and contributing to the development of scalable quantum computers based on silicon technology. 

Our team of 100+ is based across London, Sydney, San Sebastian & Maryland (US) with our main hub in our Islington lab. 


Functions of the Role

The primary function of this position will be to architect, build, and maintain our custom process design kits (PDKs) and physical verification enablements. In this role, you will sit within the IC Design team, serving as the critical bridge between foundry technologies, custom cryogenic silicon devices, and our circuit design group.
You will create custom PDK components from scratch and enable novel silicon spin-qubit and cryo-CMOS circuit design methodologies. No prior background in quantum physics is required.

  • Development of custom PDK elements from scratch, including Schematic symbols, Layout SKILL PCells, and custom DRC and LVS decks.
  • Development, qualification, and maintenance of custom Calibre SVRF rule decks tailored for non-standard layout constraints and cryogenic CMOS layout considerations.
  • Integrate tier-1 foundry PDKs into Cadence Virtuoso, creating customized library extensions, layer maps, and device callbacks.
  • Work closely with IC designers and layout engineers to establish best practices for physical verification and layout automation.
  • Document own work for peer review and evaluate the layout and enablement work of other team members.


Experience - Essentials

  • Industry degree qualification in Electronic Engineering, IC Layout, Computer Science, or a related physical science/engineering field.
  • 5+ years of hands-on industry experience in IC PDK Development and PDK enablement flow management.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in Cadence SKILL PCell coding and Virtuoso PDK customization.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in Siemens Calibre Physical Verification tools and SVRF Rule writing (specifically for DRC and LVS decks).
  • Proven hands-on experience in complex DRC and LVS error debugging within analog/mixed-signal or custom digital layout environments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a high level of self-management, self-motivation, and willingness to engage actively in peer code and layout reviews.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary physics and IC engineering teams.


Experience - Desirable

  • Demonstrated experience with advanced deep-submicron CMOS nodes (40nm, 28nm, or below), including familiarity with layout-dependent effects (LOD, WPE, OSE, etc.).
  • Expert knowledge of the Cadence Virtuoso Design Environment and Cadence SKILL / SKILL++ programming.
  • Expert knowledge of the Siemens Calibre Physical Verification Environment.
  • Familiarity with MOSFET device modeling integration (e.g., BSIM, Verilog-A) or cryogenic device enablement. 
  • General awareness or curiosity regarding semiconductor quantum dots or silicon spin qubit fundamentals. 


Benefits

  • Be part of a creative, world-leading team
  • Competitive salary and share options scheme
  • Contributory pension scheme
  • Private Medical Insurance
  • Life Assurance
  • Cycle-to-work Scheme
  • Flexible working
  • Central London location (Islington)


EEO Statement

Quantum Motion is committed to providing equal employment opportunity and does not discriminate based on age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, race, colour, religion, disability status, marital status, pregnancy, gender reassignment, or any other protected characteristics covered by the Equality Act 2010.

jobs.title: Sales Operations Manager, Foundry
jobs.description:
Sales Operations Manager, Foundry

At Instructure, we believe in the power of people to grow and succeed throughout their lives. Our goal is to amplify that power by creating intuitive products that simplify learning and personal development, facilitate meaningful relationships, and inspire people to go further in their education and careers.
We do this by giving smart, creative, passionate people opportunities to create awesome. And that's where you come in:

Foundry is a new division inside Instructure, built to generate new revenue with AI-built products. We operate as a portfolio of small pods, each charged with one product bet, under tight weekly governance. They operate independently, with dedicated resources, separate from the core business on purpose: different pace, different governance, and different rewards.

Our goal is to generate meaningful revenue within 12 to 18 months, so this isn’t an innovation lab. We’re building scaled businesses that customers pay for and retain well, and we’re measuring ourselves on revenue, not activity.

Instructure reaches roughly half of higher education in the United States, connecting a credential network of more than 13,000 institutions. Pair that distribution and data with a fast-moving team that builds leanly, and you have something no competitor has. That’s the opportunity New Markets exists to take.

How we work

A pod is two people: a Founder and a Builder, both hands on, close to the customer. The bet is deliberate: we invest in agent-developer tooling and tokens, not in headcount. An operating team of growth marketing, revenue operations, sales overlay, and G&A supports every pod, so founders stay on building products.

Every pod inherits an underlying platform with common design, development, and deployment harnesses, so no pod rebuilds the plumbing. Each pod runs through key phases with regular checkpoints where a governing board reviews progress or recommends a pivot or kill.

The rhythm is fast and transparent. Investor-style updates go out weekly. Demos and keep-or-kill checkpoints happen twice a month. Transparency is the operating model.

What you will do

You’re the operational engine behind New Markets’ newest product bets. You’ll own the end-to-end go-to-market lifecycle for pod products, from market sizing and early strategy through launch, performance tracking, and the handoff when a product graduates into the core. When a pod proves customers will pay, you make that motion repeatable and hand it to the full seller base. This is a blank-page job: the playbook doesn’t exist yet, and you’ll write it. The role reports directly to the President, New Markets, with a matrixed dotted line to Instructure’s Go-to-Market Strategy and Operations leadership.

What you’ll own

You own go-to-market operations across the portfolio, and you’re the voice of the New Markets business in the rooms where commercial decisions get made.

In practice, that means you’ll:

  • Own the end-to-end GTM lifecycle for pod products. Carry each product from market sizing and early strategy through launch planning, field execution, and post-launch performance tracking.

  • Shape the go-to-market approach with each pod. Partner with Pod Founders, marketing, and the sales overlay on ideal-customer definition, pricing and packaging input, channel strategy, and competitive positioning.

  • Design the sales motion. Build the coverage models, pipeline processes, forecasting cadences, and rules of engagement for the first seller cohort on each product.

  • Build the reporting backbone. Stand up and maintain the analytics in Salesforce and Excel that track pipeline health, win/loss, attach rates, average contract value, and renewal trends, and turn that data into insight leadership can act on.

  • Run launch readiness. Lead CRM buildout in Salesforce, playbook documentation, tool configuration, and alignment across enablement, marketing, finance, deal desk, and IT.

  • Own the graduation playbook. Define the criteria and the integration motion for products that complete a pod’s journey, so the full seller base can carry and sell the product without a messy handoff.

  • Be the voice of the business. Translate early-stage complexity into clear, data-backed narratives in planning forums, business reviews, and executive sessions, and support annual planning across capacity, quota, incentive design, and growth roadmaps.

What we expect

  • Blank page to operating framework. You go from nothing to a working system without a lot of hand-holding, then improve it as results and field feedback come in.

  • Rigor under ambiguity. You structure messy, early-stage go-to-market problems, build the analytical frame, and land a recommendation you can defend.

  • Accuracy you stand behind. The insights and reporting you put in front of leadership are right, and you own them.

  • Influence without authority. You move product, finance, marketing, and sales toward a shared plan without managing any of them.

What we’re looking for

  • Five or more years in sales operations, revenue operations, or a related go-to-market function.

  • Real experience supporting new-product launches or emerging-business initiatives, where the playbook didn’t exist yet.

  • Three or more years hands-on in Salesforce, building and maintaining reports, dashboards, and data structures.

  • Advanced Excel, comfortable building models, running variance analysis, and turning raw data into decision-ready output.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including executive-level presentations. A bachelor’s degree is preferred.

Your first 90 days

  • Month 1. Immerse yourself in the New Markets portfolio, the key stakeholders, and the current go-to-market infrastructure. Understand where each product sits in its lifecycle and find the most pressing operational gaps.

  • Month 3. Establish a clear view of performance across active pods: pipeline health, coverage, and leading indicators. Build or refine the reporting framework in Salesforce and Excel, and set a recurring operating rhythm with product and sales leadership.

  • Month 6. Own and drive the go-to-market motion for at least one pod through a checkpoint. Deliver an integration-readiness recommendation for any product approaching graduation, and present a prioritized roadmap for improving New Markets go-to-market operations to senior leadership.

This role isn’t for everyone

Anti-patterns. You should probably pass if:

  • You need an established playbook and a stable process to operate inside. Here you build the playbook.

  • You’re uncomfortable being measured on the accuracy of your numbers and the clarity of your recommendations.

  • You’d rather own a single, well-defined process than the whole messy go-to-market surface across a portfolio.

  • A predictable, slow-changing scope is what you want. The portfolio shifts as pods move through their checkpoints.

Compensation

Base pay is market-competitive. You’ll be paid fairly against the market for the work, so you’re not taking a pay cut to be here. But the base is the floor, not the prize.

The real value is the upside you drive. As part of the operating team, you share in a cash bonus pool tied to portfolio milestones across pods. Targets are set as pods launch, so you’ll know what the portfolio is running at.

The upside is asymmetric, and it’s earned, not granted. There’s a hard floor: below a threshold level of attainment, milestone payouts don’t trigger at all. Above it, hitting and stretching past your targets pays meaningfully. This is built to be the kind of outcome that changes your trajectory, not a routine bonus. The rewards go to the people who build something customers pay for. They don’t reward effort, tenure, or proximity.

What this means in plain terms. Real ownership. Real accountability. Real upside for the people who build a business, and very little for those who don’t. If that trade excites you, you’re the person we’re looking for. If it worries you, trust that instinct.

Get in on all the awesome at Instructure!

We offer competitive, meaningful benefits in every country where we operate. While they vary by location, here's a general idea of what you can expect:

  • Competitive compensation, plus all full-time employees participate in our ownership program - because everyone should have a stake in our success.

  • Flexible work culture. Our remote, hybrid and in-office collaboration spaces vary by role, team and location.

  • Generous time off, including local holidays and our annual “Dim the Lights” period in late December, when teams are encouraged to step back and recharge based on departmental needs.

  • Comprehensive wellness programs and mental health support

  • Learning and development resources, including professional development tools and tuition reimbursement, to support your growth

  • The technology and tools you need to do your best work

  • Motivosity employee recognition program

  • A culture rooted in inclusivity, support, and meaningful connection

We believe in hiring great people and treating them right. The more diverse we are, the better our ideas and outcomes.

Instructure is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We comply with applicable employment and anti-discrimination laws in every country where we operate.

All employees must pass a background check as part of the hiring process. To help protect our teams and systems, we’ve implemented identity verification measures. Candidates may be asked to verify their legal name, current physical location, and provide a valid contact number and residential address, in accordance with local data privacy laws.

Any attempt to misrepresent personal or professional information will result in disqualification.

Product Designer, Shop Everything

Instagram is seeking a Product Designer to help lead our Shop Everything effort. Shop Everything is our bet that any piece of content on Instagram can become a storefront — that when you spot a jacket in a creator's morning routine, a lamp in a travel Reel, or a skincare product in a friend's Story, you should be able to tap and buy it, or discover five others like it, without ever leaving the app. We're building a world where shopping is as native to the experience as liking or commenting: seamless, trustworthy, and rewarding for the creators who make it possible. As a key member of our design team, you will be responsible for ensuring that our products and features are valuable, easy to use, and of the highest level of craft and execution.In this role, you will design both sides of that exchange. On the creator side, you will empower creators to monetize their content and grow their businesses — defining how they add products to their content, how those products show up to their audience across Feed, Reels, Stories, and Profile, and how AI-assisted flows like automatic product tagging and search across millions of catalogs make earning from their content feel effortless rather than transactional. On the consumer side, you will turn inspiration into action across the end-to-end purchase experience, from the moment of interest through consideration, cart, and checkout. That means rebuilding the product detail page around AI-assisted decision-making rather than static product information, designing a cart that persists across Instagram so people can gather things over time and return when they're ready, defining how much of a purchase someone can delegate to an AI agent and how they stay in control of it, and earning trust across a marketplace of third-party sellers with uneven product data and different ways of checking out. The ambition on both sides is to be differentiated and forward-looking: defining new patterns and experiences rather than replicating existing ones. jobs.title: Senior AI Enablement Specialist - FE
jobs.description:
Senior AI Enablement Specialist - FE

Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the Role:

Kong's IT team is standing up a new capability: a small, specialized group that goes directly into business functions and builds AI into how work gets done. We call them AI Enablement Specialists — and we're looking for a senior practitioner to help lead that effort.

This isn't an advisory role. You'll be hands-on with the teams you support, building tools that solve real problems and helping people develop new skills they'll carry forward. The scope is company-wide — Sales, Marketing, Finance, HR, Legal, Customer Success, and beyond. You'll have the autonomy to prioritize where your time creates the most value, and the backing of IT leadership to get things done.

If you've already done this kind of work — transforming how people and teams operate through AI — and you're looking for an environment where you can do it at scale with real ownership, this is the role.

What You'll Do:

  • Spend time inside business teams to understand how they actually work — their tools, processes, pain points, and highest-priority outputs.

  • Build AI-powered workflows, automations, and custom tools that address real bottlenecks and deliver measurable time savings.

  • Help team members develop their own AI skills through one-on-one coaching, working sessions, and structured practice — moving them from early experimentation to confident, independent use.

  • Recognize when a solution built for one team applies to others, and do the work to make it reusable across the organization.

  • Establish a clear framework for tracking AI adoption progress across business units and report findings to IT leadership on a regular cadence.

  • Set documentation standards for the team — every tool, workflow, and lesson learned should be captured so it doesn't live only in your head.

  • Help develop Kong's internal AI governance standards in partnership with IT, Security, and Engineering.

  • Mentor junior team members and interns, giving them hands-on experience and clear feedback.

  • Stay current on AI developments and translate what's relevant into practical applications for Kong's business context.

What You'll Bring:

Minimum Requirements

About Concept Plus
Concept Plus is a growing consulting firm headquartered in Fairfax, VA. We are an Oracle Gold Partner, offering deep technical expertise, combined with business insights and an experienced team focused on providing technical solutions for our clients. We are proud to have been recognized as one of the "25 Most Powerful Oracle Solution Providers" in the area! For additional information about our dynamic organization, please visit our website. at www.conceptplus.com. 


About the role

We are seeking a Capture Management Director to capture new business leveraging our presence and capabilities in key and emerging accounts. These high-end capabilities include data analytics, digital transformation, cloud and infrastructure, and Oracle Solutions.
This opportunity is unique. At Concept Plus, we understand the impact a great leader can have on our business. We are looking for an emerging leader who is seeking a role where they can truly shape a business and define the next generation of services we will deliver to our customers.
We possess a strong work ethic, focus on solutions and options instead of problems and challenges and maintain a relentless focus on our customers and our people. You must possess exceptional consulting skills, people skills, communication skills, analytical skills, capture skills, and account management skills. You should expect to work hard, be creative, learn every day in addition to leading, roll your sleeves up to get the job done, and be excited by the idea of building something amazing.
You will work directly for Vice President of Proposal Operations, collaborate with the P&L leader for that strategic opportunity, and join a talented executive team that has a strong collaborative and entrepreneurial spirit. You will play a critical role in the development and execution of a high growth strategy and other duties as assigned. If you are ready for this challenge and meet the requirements below, we are excited to meet you!
The Capture Director serves as a force multiplier for growth, leading teams from qualified opportunity through award. This highly visible role will be at the center of the pursuit of our highest value opportunities, working closely with the CGO and Business Unit leadership, Business Development, Proposal Management, Pricing, Contracts and other functions.

jobs.description:
Team Lead, Account Development Representatives

Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the Role:

Kong is hiring an ADR Team Lead to support our NEMEA region: the UK, Benelux, and Nordics. This is a player-coach role. You'll carry your own pipeline targets while taking an active hand in developing the team around you, especially the newer ADRs still finding their footing.

You'll work closely with, and report into, the Senior Manager for NEMEA. You're shaping how the team operates, not running it solo. Think of this as a high-impact individual contributor role with a leadership layer built in: the natural next step for an ADR who's ready to start making other people better, not just themselves.

Our NEMEA team is already strong. Driven, independent, hitting their numbers. What they need isn't more oversight. They need someone who sharpens how the team works, especially around process and tooling, while making sure newer reps get the support to ramp fast.

You'll report to Oscar Winberg. He moves fast, sets a high bar, and expects people to bring solutions, not just flag problems. He's direct, so you'll always know exactly where you stand, and he expects that same directness back: if you disagree, he wants the pushback, backed by data, not silence. Earn his trust and he'll hand you real ownership. What he won't do is hand-hold, so this role suits someone who'd rather be given room to run than told exactly what to do.

What You'll Do:

Carry your own number. You'll hit your own pipeline targets as an active ADR. Your activity and results set the standard for everyone watching. You'll contribute to weekly forecasting alongside the Senior Manager.

Support newer ADRs. You'll be the first point of contact for less tenured reps, helping them ramp faster and build good habits early. You'll help with onboarding alongside the Senior Manager and Enablement, and run regular 1:1s with newer ADRs. Different reps need different things from you, so you'll read where each person is and adjust your coaching accordingly rather than running the same playbook on everyone. You'll help build individual development plans grounded in a real read of each rep's attitude, process, and results, and you'll flag underperformance early, with context, instead of letting it fester.

Coach and upskill the team. You'll support team coaching sessions: live dialling, pitch practice, feedback loops. You'll run or contribute to upskilling initiatives, on your own or with Enablement. You'll share what's working, best practices, sequences, outbound approaches, with the wider team, and give direct, specific feedback often, recognizing strong work and not letting bad habits slide.

Sharpen process and tooling. You'll help spot where the team's workflows and tooling could run more efficiently, and support the Senior Manager in rolling out improvements without stripping reps of their autonomy. You'll be the go-to person for best practice on Salesforce, Outreach, and the team's automation tools.

Contribute to the wider GTM motion. You'll keep strong alignment with your AE partners and take part in pipe review cadences. You'll support the Senior Manager in preparing performance updates and regional insights, and join bi-weekly RD cadences where it makes sense.

What You'll Bring:

  • Hands-on ADR or SDR experience. You know what this job feels like from the inside, not just what it looks like from a deck.

  • A real coach's instinct. You get energy from making other people better, not just from hitting your own number.

  • The ability to juggle competing priorities without dropping the ball. Your own quota, coaching newer reps, and process work will all pull on your time in the same week, and you know how to decide what actually matters right now.

  • Strong time management. This is one we screen for directly, not something we assume comes with experience.

  • A bias for building. You spot what needs fixing and go build it, rather than working only through a list of tasks someone else handed you.

  • Analytical rigor. You make calls based on data, not gut feel, and you're comfortable being specific about why a number moved, including when that number is going the wrong way.

  • You touch the line. Your metrics back it up: leading indicators (activity, sequence execution, pipeline hygiene) and lagging indicators (quota attainment, pipeline generated) that show a track record of real discipline, not one good quarter.

  • Real trust with your AE and RD partners, earned through consistency, not just alignment on paper.

  • Transparency, especially with leadership, especially when something isn't on track. We'd rather hear it early than find out later.

  • The kind of presence the team actually looks up to, not just reports to.

  • Comfort in an allbound model with a heavy outbound emphasis.

  • Self-awareness and a genuine investment in growing as a leader.

  • Language skills relevant to the UK, Benelux, or Nordics are a bonus, not a requirement.

We'll consider strong internal and external candidates. For external hires, the bar is high: we're looking for someone who brings something genuinely differentiated.

Culture and Values:

The EMEA SDR team are weather makers. We don't wait for opportunity, we create it. We're accountable, relentless, and we invest in each other like no other team does.

  • Relentless. Energy and intention every day. Every challenge is a chance to get stronger.

  • Character. Good humans first. Integrity, humility, and keeping our word.

  • Together. No one gets left behind. Differences make us better, not harder to manage.

  • Truth. Radical honesty. We say the hard things with care. That's how we move fast.

  • Accountable. We own our results, bias toward action, and don't wait to be told.

  • Pioneering. We take up space, experiment, and bring creative thinking to every challenge.

In NEMEA specifically, we operate in mature markets. We don't manufacture urgency, we earn entry by knowing the landscape better than the prospect does. We're pipeline gardeners: patient, precise, persistent.

"We don't book meetings. We build pipeline."

This role is a genuine development opportunity. For the right person, it's the foundation of a leadership career at Kong.

Interested? Reach out to Oscar Winberg to discuss.

Manager, Customer Success - Upmarket

Our Mission:

6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

Our People:

People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.

The Role

As a Manager, Customer Success, you will lead a team of approximately 7-8 Customer Success Managers responsible for a combined portfolio of Upmarket customers with annual contract values ranging from $100K to $500K and representing approximately $15M-$20M in ARR.

You will be responsible for driving customer retention, adoption, customer value realization, and operational excellence across your team's portfolio while developing and coaching a high-performing team of Customer Success Managers. This role requires a strong people leader who can balance business performance, talent development, forecasting discipline, and customer outcomes.

Success in this role requires the ability to develop top talent, create accountability, establish operational rigor, and partner cross-functionally to ensure customers realize measurable business value from their investment in 6sense.

You will work closely with Sales, Professional Services, Support, Product, Marketing, and Revenue Operations to help customers achieve their goals while contributing to the continued growth and scale of the Customer Success organization.

What You'll Do

Lead and Develop a High-Performing Team

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of approximately 7-8 Customer Success Managers supporting Upmarket customers.
  • Create a culture of accountability, customer-centricity, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Conduct regular coaching sessions, performance reviews, talent assessments, and career development conversations.
  • Establish clear expectations and operating rhythms that drive consistent execution and customer outcomes.
  • Recruit, onboard, and develop Customer Success talent while supporting succession planning across the organization.
  • Inspire and motivate a team that consistently delivers exceptional customer experiences and business results.

Drive Customer Success Outcomes

  • Lead a team responsible for customers with annual contract values between $100K and $500K and a combined portfolio of approximately $15M-$20M in ARR.
  • Drive strong Gross Revenue Retention (GRR), customer adoption, customer satisfaction, and value realization across the portfolio.
  • Coach Customer Success Managers on account strategy, executive stakeholder engagement, success planning, renewal strategy, risk mitigation, and value delivery, ensuring they understand and own the renewal process.
  • Ensure Customer Success Managers proactively identify customer risks and execute strategies to improve retention outcomes.
  • Partner with Sales leadership to align on customer health, growth opportunities, and strategic account planning.
  • Drive a high level of customer engagement and executive alignment across key accounts.

Drive Operational Excellence

  • Own portfolio forecasting processes, renewal inspections, customer health reviews, and risk management practices.
  • Ensure consistent execution of success plans, Executive Business Reviews (EBRs), account reviews, and customer engagement standards.
  • Use data and analytics to identify trends, improve performance, and drive informed decision-making.
  • Drive adoption of Customer Success processes, tools, and best practices across the team.
  • Champion initiatives that improve efficiency, scalability, forecast accuracy, and customer outcomes.

Partner Across the Business

  • Collaborate closely with Sales, Product, Professional Services, Support, Marketing, and RevOps to deliver a world-class customer experience.
  • Act as a voice of the customer and advocate for customer needs across the organization.
  • Support strategic initiatives focused on customer retention, product adoption, operational scale, and customer value realization.
  • Help shape the future of Customer Success programs, processes, and operating models as the business continues to grow.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of people leadership experience leading customer-facing teams within a SaaS organization.
  • 8+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Professional Services, Consulting, or other customer-facing roles.
  • Proven track record of building, developing, and retaining high-performing teams.
  • Experience leading teams responsible for customer retention, adoption, and customer outcomes.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS business models and key metrics, including GRR, churn, forecasting, customer health, and product adoption.
  • Experience coaching teams on executive engagement, account strategy, value realization, and risk management.
  • Excellent communication, coaching, and leadership skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive operational rigor and accountability through data-driven management practices.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into action.
  • Comfortable leveraging AI-powered tools and workflows to improve team productivity, customer insights, coaching effectiveness, and operational scale.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Ability to travel up to 25% for customer meetings, team events, and company programs.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing teams responsible for portfolios between $15M and $20M in ARR.
  • Experience within MarTech, AdTech, SalesTech, Revenue Technology, or related B2B SaaS industries.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Gainsight, Clari, Gong, and other customer success technologies.
  • Experience helping scale Customer Success organizations, teams, and operating models.

Why 6sense

At 6sense, you'll have the opportunity to lead a talented team, influence the future of Customer Success, and directly impact customer retention and business outcomes across a diverse portfolio of Upmarket customers.

You'll work alongside some of the industry's most innovative leaders while helping customers transform how they identify, engage, and convert buyers. You'll have the autonomy to make an impact, the support of a world-class leadership team, and the opportunity to grow your career while developing the next generation of Customer Success talent.

If you're passionate about building great teams, creating exceptional customer outcomes, and helping scale a world-class Customer Success organization, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Customer Experience Associate
jobs.description:
Customer Experience Associate

Customer Experience Associate

Peerspace · Customer Experience · Entry level

Peerspace is the leading and category defining online marketplace for venue rentals for meetings, productions, and events. We open doors to the most inspiring spaces around the world, from lofts and mansions to storefronts and studios. Over $500M has been transacted through the platform, and our investors include GV (Google Ventures) and Foundation Capital.

Our people are the heart of Peerspace. We are a team that values inclusion and working cross functionally. Our strategy and objectives are clear and we support one another to exceed expectations. We believe that a healthy company culture creates an environment where people are excited to come into work everyday and contribute to building a successful organization.

About the role

Most routine questions get answered before they ever reach a person. What's left are the conversations that actually need one: a host and a guest who remember the same booking differently, a photographer whose shoot starts in three hours and the space just fell through, a situation where we don’t have a policy in place to resolve.

That's the work. As a Customer Experience Associate, you'll handle the cases that require judgment, empathy, and a bit of creative problem solving; and in the process you'll learn how a two-sided marketplace actually works, from the inside out.

What you'll do

  • Work a queue of guest and host conversations across chat, email, phone, and SMS, focused on the cases that were routed to a person for a reason.

  • Resolve booking issues, mediate misunderstandings between hosts and guests, and process cancellations and adjustments accurately.

  • Use our AI assist tools and knowledge base to draft and check responses; then edit for accuracy and tone. You're the one who decides what actually gets sent.

  • Look for chances to surprise and delight someone, and take them.

  • Flag recurring issues, confusing policies, and product friction to Specialists and leadership so they get fixed rather than re-answered.

  • Hit response-time and quality targets while keeping careful, complete case notes.

  • Show up for your team: standups, Slack etc… be a part of the culture that makes this a stellar place to work.

What we're looking for

You lead with empathy and keep the customer's interest front and center, even when the answer is no. You write clearly and warmly, and you care about grammar and tone. You can carry a case all the way to resolution without being chased, and you know the difference between a call you should make yourself and one you should escalate.

You're comfortable with technology and genuinely curious about working alongside AI tools. You are confident enough to use them well, but skeptical enough to check their work. New tools and policy changes don't rattle you. You can read your own queue and quality metrics and do something useful with what they tell you.

On paper, that usually looks like:

  • 1–2 years experience in customer service, hospitality, support, or something adjacent.

  • Strong writing skills with real attention to detail.

  • A sense of humor and genuine enthusiasm for helping people.

  • Bonus points if you have third party marketplace experience.

  • Additional bonus points for any experience with Intercom.

Schedule - 4 week rotation:

  • Weeks 1-3:

    • Monday - Friday; 8 hours/day (hours flexible depending on time zone)

  • Week 4:

    • Monday & Tuesday; 8 hours/day (hours flexible depending on time zone)

    • Wednesday & Thursday; OFF

    • Friday - Sunday; 8 hours/day (hours flexible depending on time zone)

The hourly rate for this role is $25.00/hour.

Peerspace is proudly certified as a Great Place to Work™ and we're a remote first company with team members located in cities around the globe. Beyond competitive salary and equity compensation, we provide a range of benefits and perks, including:

● 100% employee coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance

● $500 annual professional development allowance

● Discount on all Peerspace bookings

● Laptop, high res display, and stipend to setup home office

● Monthly cell phone and internet credit

● Annual In person all company offsite and team-building events (in Peerspace locations, of course)

● Wellness Days observed company wide

Diversity

At Peerspace, we're dedicated to creating a team that's diverse, equitable and inclusive. Our workplace is a space where all team members are empowered to blaze their own trail, make things happen, and take pride in their work. We believe bringing people together from different backgrounds and identities makes us stronger and better serves the Peerspace community. We'd especially like to encourage applicants from different backgrounds, locations, and experiences.

At Peerspace, we are committed to maintaining a secure and transparent hiring experience. Please be aware that scammers sometimes impersonate companies like ours by posting fake job listings or reaching out to job seekers in misleading ways. All legitimate communication from Peerspace will come from an official @peerspace.com email address. We do not contact candidates through personal email accounts, third-party messaging apps such as WhatsApp or Microsoft Teams, or through the Peerspace platform's internal messaging system. All interviews are conducted only by phone or Zoom, and we will never ask for sensitive personal or financial information such as your Social Security number or bank details during the early stages of the hiring process. If you receive any message that seems suspicious or does not align with these practices, please contact us immediately at help@peerspace.com so we can investigate. We only post our job openings and process applications, through our official careers page at https://jobs.lever.co/peerspace.
